audience: Beginner through advanced learners; everyday basics, intermediate practice, and advanced sentence patterns
level_system: Editorial review/core/stretch labels (foundation/intermediate/advanced in the game); not an official HSK grammar or vocabulary mapping
content_status: Original authored draft with automated structural validation; no independent linguistic review
pinyin_convention: Lowercase tone-marked syllables separated by spaces; dictionary tones for 一 and 不; neutral tones unmarked; 儿 shown as a separate er syllable. Generated with pypinyin and contextual overrides, not phonetic audio transcription.

answer_policy.normalization: NFKC; remove Unicode whitespace and punctuation only; preserve Chinese characters and word order
answer_policy.unmatched_answer_label: Not in the accepted answer list
answer_policy.note: An unmatched answer may still be a valid translation. Do not equate allowlist mismatch with proven grammatical error. Scoring and lives behavior is for the game implementation to decide.

feedback_policy: After submission, show expected Chinese, pinyin, English, the parent rule explanation, and the three referenced exercises as examples. References stay within the rule and exclude the submitted exercise; they may appear as practice questions in other rounds.

rules.title: Present descriptions
rules.explanation: Use 很 before a simple adjectival predicate when describing a quality without making a comparison. In this pattern 很 often links the subject and adjective rather than strongly emphasizing 'very'. Do not add 是 before an ordinary adjective.

rules.title: Possession with 的
rules.explanation: Place the possessor before 的 and the thing possessed after it. 的 may be omitted in some close relationships, but keeping it is a useful default. An English possessive pronoun becomes a Chinese pronoun plus 的.

rules.title: Describing nouns with 的
rules.explanation: A phrase describing a noun normally comes before that noun and is linked with 的. This includes full clauses; Chinese does not place an equivalent of 'who' or 'that' after the noun.

rules.title: Location with 在
rules.explanation: Use 在 as the predicate to say where someone or something is. For actions happening at a location, place 在 plus the location before the action verb instead.

rules.title: Actions at a location
rules.explanation: Place the location phrase 在… before the action verb. This tells where the action happens, not where the subject goes as a result of the action.

rules.title: Existence with 有
rules.explanation: Start with a location and use 有 to introduce something present there. Negate 有 with 没有, not 不有. This structure introduces a thing rather than locating an already identified thing.

rules.title: Time before the verb
rules.explanation: Put a time expression before the verb, either before or after the subject. Chinese verbs do not change form for tense; the time expression supplies the time reference.

rules.title: Negation with 不
rules.explanation: Use 不 for habits, unwillingness, future refusals, and many descriptions. To deny that an event occurred, usually use 没 instead. 不 precedes the verb or adjective it negates.

rules.title: Negation with 没
rules.explanation: Use 没 or 没有 to say that an event did not happen or has not happened. Normally remove completed-action 了 when negating that event. 没有 also negates possession and existence.

rules.title: Yes-no questions with 吗
rules.explanation: Add 吗 to a statement to ask whether it is true. Keep ordinary statement word order. Do not combine this 吗 pattern with an A-not-A question or a question word such as 什么.

rules.title: A-not-A questions
rules.explanation: Ask a yes-no question by repeating a verb or adjective with 不 between the two forms. Use 有没有 for 有. This pattern normally replaces sentence-final 吗.

rules.title: Approximate numbers
rules.pattern: Adjacent numbers / number + 几 or 多 + measure word
rules.explanation: Put adjacent numbers before a measure word for an approximate amount, such as 两三天 ('two or three days'). 十几 means ten-odd (eleven to nineteen), and a round number plus 多 means more than that number. For ages, 三十多岁 means in one's thirties. Do not insert 或者 inside an adjacent-number expression.

expected.english: This cup of coffee is a little bitter.

rules.title: Adjusting degree with 一点儿
rules.explanation: Place 一点儿 after an adjective to ask for a small adjustment or specify a small difference. In requests, the understood comparison is with the current degree: slower, louder, or cheaper.

exercises.prompt_english: Please speak a little more slowly.

expected.pinyin: qǐng shuō màn yī diǎn er.
expected.english: Please speak a little more slowly.

exercises.prompt_english: Could it be a little cheaper?

expected.pinyin: néng pián yi yī diǎn er ma?
expected.english: Could it be a little cheaper?

exercises.prompt_english: Please write a little more clearly.

expected.pinyin: qǐng xiě qīng chǔ yī diǎn er.
expected.english: Please write a little more clearly.

exercises.prompt_english: I want to live a little closer.

expected.pinyin: wǒ xiǎng zhù jìn yī diǎn er.
expected.english: I want to live a little closer.

exercises.prompt_english: Please keep your voice a little lower.

expected.pinyin: qǐng shēng yīn xiǎo yī diǎn er.
expected.english: Please keep your voice a little lower.

exercises.prompt_english: Let us set off a little earlier this time.

expected.chinese: 这次我们早一点儿出发吧。
expected.pinyin: zhè cì wǒ men zǎo yī diǎn er chū fā ba.
expected.english: Let us set off a little earlier this time.

accepted_answers: 这次我们早一点儿出发吧。

exercises.prompt_english: Please sit a little farther away.

expected.pinyin: qǐng zuò yuǎn yī diǎn er.
expected.english: Please sit a little farther away.

exercises.prompt_english: You should be a little more careful.

expected.pinyin: nǐ yīng gāi rèn zhēn yī diǎn er.
expected.english: You should be a little more careful.

exercises.prompt_english: I want to buy a slightly bigger one.

expected.pinyin: wǒ xiǎng mǎi dà yī diǎn er de.
expected.english: I want to buy a slightly bigger one.

exercises.prompt_english: Tidy the room up a little more thoroughly.

accepted_answers: 把房间收拾干净一点儿。

rules.title: Excessive or emphatic degree with 太…了
rules.explanation: Use 太…了 for a strong degree, which can be excessive ('too') or enthusiastic ('so') depending on context. The final 了 belongs to the exclamatory pattern and is not a past-tense marker.

exercises.prompt_english: This piece of clothing is too expensive.

expected.pinyin: zhè jiàn yī fú tài guì le.
expected.english: This piece of clothing is too expensive.

exercises.prompt_english: It is too hot today.

expected.pinyin: jīn tiān tài rè le.
expected.english: It is too hot today.

exercises.prompt_english: You are so kind.

expected.pinyin: nǐ tài kè qì le.
expected.english: You are so kind.

exercises.prompt_english: This news is wonderful.

expected.pinyin: zhè ge xiāo xī tài hǎo le.
expected.english: This news is wonderful.

exercises.prompt_english: This question is too difficult.

expected.pinyin: zhè dào tí tài nán le.
expected.english: This question is too difficult.

exercises.prompt_english: It is too noisy here.

expected.pinyin: zhè lǐ tài chǎo le.
expected.english: It is too noisy here.

exercises.prompt_english: This movie is so interesting.

expected.pinyin: zhè bù diàn yǐng tài yǒu yì si le.

exercises.prompt_english: There is too little time.

expected.pinyin: shí jiān tài duǎn le.

exercises.prompt_english: This suitcase is too heavy.

expected.pinyin: zhè ge xiāng zi tài zhòng le.
expected.english: This suitcase is too heavy.

exercises.prompt_english: You came back too late.

expected.pinyin: nǐ huí de tài wǎn le.
expected.english: You came back too late.

rules.title: Extreme degree with 极了
rules.explanation: Put 极了 after an adjective to express an extreme degree, similar to 'extremely'. It follows the description rather than preceding it like 非常.

exercises.prompt_english: I am extremely tired today.

expected.pinyin: wǒ jīn tiān lèi jí le.
expected.english: I am extremely tired today.

exercises.prompt_english: The scenery here is extremely beautiful.

expected.pinyin: zhè lǐ de fēng jǐng měi jí le.

exercises.prompt_english: The children are extremely happy.

expected.pinyin: hái zi men gāo xìng jí le.
expected.english: The children are extremely happy.

exercises.prompt_english: This dish is extremely delicious.

expected.pinyin: zhè dào cài hǎo chī jí le.
expected.english: This dish is extremely delicious.

exercises.prompt_english: It is extremely quiet in the room.

expected.pinyin: fáng jiān lǐ ān jìng jí le.
expected.english: It is extremely quiet in the room.

exercises.prompt_english: She was extremely sad after hearing the news.

expected.chinese: 她听到消息后伤心极了。
expected.pinyin: tā tīng dào xiāo xī hòu shāng xīn jí le.
expected.english: She was extremely sad after hearing the news.

accepted_answers: 她听到消息后伤心极了。

exercises.prompt_english: The air on the mountain is excellent.

expected.pinyin: shān shàng de kōng qì hǎo jí le.
expected.english: The air on the mountain is excellent.

exercises.prompt_english: These shoes are extremely comfortable.

expected.pinyin: zhè shuāng xié shū fú jí le.
expected.english: These shoes are extremely comfortable.

exercises.prompt_english: This story is extremely interesting.

expected.pinyin: zhè ge gù shì yǒu qù jí le.
expected.english: This story is extremely interesting.

exercises.prompt_english: He is extremely anxious.

expected.pinyin: tā zháo jí jí le.
expected.english: He is extremely anxious.

rules.title: Further degree with 更
rules.explanation: Place 更 before an adjective to mean 'even more' or 'more' relative to an understood or stated comparison. It can occur inside a 比 sentence as an added emphasis.

exercises.prompt_english: I want to find a better job.

expected.chinese: 我想找一份更好的工作。
expected.pinyin: wǒ xiǎng zhǎo yī fèn gèng hǎo de gōng zuò.
expected.english: I want to find a better job.

accepted_answers: 我想找一份更好的工作。

exercises.prompt_english: Today is even colder than yesterday.

expected.pinyin: jīn tiān bǐ zuó tiān gèng lěng.

exercises.prompt_english: This method is simpler.

exercises.prompt_english: Taking the subway would be faster.

expected.english: Taking the subway would be faster.

exercises.prompt_english: I prefer the blue one.

expected.pinyin: wǒ gèng xǐ huān lán sè de.
expected.english: I prefer the blue one.

exercises.prompt_english: She hopes to have more time with her family.

expected.chinese: 她希望有更多时间陪家人。
expected.pinyin: tā xī wàng yǒu gèng duō shí jiān péi jiā rén.
expected.english: She hopes to have more time with her family.

accepted_answers: 她希望有更多时间陪家人。

exercises.prompt_english: Changing rooms would be quieter.

expected.pinyin: huàn gè fáng jiān huì gèng ān jìng.
expected.english: Changing rooms would be quieter.

exercises.prompt_english: After practicing, you will be more confident.

expected.chinese: 练习以后，你会更有信心。
expected.pinyin: liàn xí yǐ hòu, nǐ huì gèng yǒu xìn xīn.
expected.english: After practicing, you will be more confident.

accepted_answers: 练习以后，你会更有信心。

exercises.prompt_english: We need a clearer explanation.

expected.chinese: 我们需要更清楚的解释。
expected.pinyin: wǒ men xū yào gèng qīng chǔ de jiě shì.
expected.english: We need a clearer explanation.

accepted_answers: 我们需要更清楚的解释。

exercises.prompt_english: Although this route is a little longer, it is safer.

expected.chinese: 这条路虽然远一点，但是更安全。

expected.english: Although this route is a little longer, it is safer.

accepted_answers: 这条路虽然远一点，但是更安全。

rules.title: Not at all with 一点儿也不
rules.pattern: 一点儿 + 也/都 + 不/没 + predicate
rules.explanation: Use 一点儿也不 or 一点儿都不 for emphatic 'not at all'. With events or possession, use 没 or 没有 as appropriate. The tiny amount expression must be interpreted with the following negation.

exercises.prompt_english: I am not tired at all.

expected.pinyin: wǒ yī diǎn er yě bù lèi.
expected.english: I am not tired at all.

exercises.prompt_english: This question is not difficult at all.

expected.pinyin: zhè dào tí yī diǎn er yě bù nán.
expected.english: This question is not difficult at all.

exercises.prompt_english: She is not angry at all.

expected.pinyin: tā yī diǎn er yě bù shēng qì.
expected.english: She is not angry at all.

exercises.prompt_english: It is not cold here at all.

expected.pinyin: zhè lǐ yī diǎn er yě bù lěng.
expected.english: It is not cold here at all.

exercises.prompt_english: I do not like this movie at all.

expected.chinese: 我一点儿也不喜欢这部电影。
expected.pinyin: wǒ yī diǎn er yě bù xǐ huān zhè bù diàn yǐng.
expected.english: I do not like this movie at all.

accepted_answers: 我一点儿也不喜欢这部电影。

exercises.prompt_english: He is not worried at all.

expected.pinyin: tā yī diǎn er yě bù dān xīn.
expected.english: He is not worried at all.

exercises.prompt_english: This matter is not strange at all.

expected.chinese: 这件事一点儿也不奇怪。
expected.pinyin: zhè jiàn shì yī diǎn er yě bù qí guài.
expected.english: This matter is not strange at all.

accepted_answers: 这件事一点儿也不奇怪。

exercises.prompt_english: I did not understand any of what I heard.

expected.pinyin: wǒ yī diǎn er yě méi tīng dǒng.
expected.english: I did not understand any of what I heard.

expected.english: She does not want to go at all.

rules.title: Both and all with 都
rules.explanation: Put 都 before the predicate to distribute it across a previously identified group: 'all' or 'both'. 都不 negates the predicate for everyone; 不都 means 'not all' and has a different scope.

exercises.prompt_english: We all like Chinese food.

expected.pinyin: wǒ men dōu xǐ huān zhōng guó cài.
expected.english: We all like Chinese food.

exercises.prompt_english: I have read both of these books.

expected.pinyin: zhè liǎng běn shū wǒ dōu kàn guò.
expected.english: I have read both of these books.

exercises.prompt_english: All the students have arrived.

expected.pinyin: xué shēng men dōu dào le.
expected.english: All the students have arrived.

exercises.prompt_english: None of them can drive.

expected.pinyin: tā men dōu bù huì kāi chē.
expected.english: None of them can drive.

exercises.prompt_english: All these clothes are expensive.

expected.pinyin: zhè xiē yī fú dōu hěn guì.
expected.english: All these clothes are expensive.

exercises.prompt_english: My mom and dad are both teachers.

expected.pinyin: wǒ bà bà mā mā dōu shì lǎo shī.
expected.english: My mom and dad are both teachers.

exercises.prompt_english: All three of these questions are important.

expected.pinyin: zhè sān gè wèn tí dōu hěn zhòng yào.
expected.english: All three of these questions are important.

exercises.prompt_english: Not all of us live in Beijing.

expected.pinyin: wǒ men bù dōu zhù zài běi jīng.
expected.english: Not all of us live in Beijing.

exercises.prompt_english: Everyone is ready.

expected.pinyin: dà jiā dōu zhǔn bèi hǎo le.
expected.english: Everyone is ready.

exercises.prompt_english: Both of these routes can be taken.

expected.pinyin: zhè liǎng tiáo lù dōu kě yǐ zǒu.
expected.english: Both of these routes can be taken.

rules.title: Reasons with 因为…所以…
rules.explanation: Use 因为 to introduce a cause and 所以 to introduce its result. Chinese can use both in one sentence. Either can sometimes be omitted when the relationship is already clear.

exercises.prompt_english: Because it was raining, we did not go to the park.

expected.chinese: 因为下雨，所以我们没去公园。

expected.english: Because it was raining, we did not go to the park.

accepted_answers: 因为下雨，所以我们没去公园。

exercises.prompt_english: Because I am sick, I am taking leave today.

expected.chinese: 因为我生病了，所以今天请假。

expected.english: Because I am sick, I am taking leave today.

expected.pinyin: yīn wèi lù shàng dǔ chē, suǒ yǐ tā chí dào le.
expected.english: Because there was a traffic jam, he was late.

accepted_answers: 因为路上堵车，所以他迟到了。

exercises.prompt_english: Because this shop is cheap, there are many people here.

expected.chinese: 因为这家店便宜，所以人很多。
expected.pinyin: yīn wèi zhè jiā diàn pián yi, suǒ yǐ rén hěn duō.
expected.english: Because this shop is cheap, there are many people here.

accepted_answers: 因为这家店便宜，所以人很多。

exercises.prompt_english: Because there is an exam tomorrow, I need to review.

expected.chinese: 因为明天考试，所以我要复习。

exercises.prompt_english: Because she lives far away, she leaves home early every day.

expected.english: Because she lives far away, she leaves home early every day.

accepted_answers: 因为她住得远，所以每天很早出门。

exercises.prompt_english: Because I did not bring an umbrella, I got wet in the rain.

expected.pinyin: yīn wèi shí jiān bù gòu, suǒ yǐ wǒ men zuò le chū zū chē.

accepted_answers: 因为时间不够，所以我们坐了出租车。

rules.title: Concession with 虽然…但是…
rules.pattern: 虽然 + fact，但是 + contrasting fact
rules.explanation: Use 虽然 for an acknowledged fact and 但是 for an unexpected or contrasting fact. Both connectors can appear together in Chinese. 可是 and 不过 are possible contrast connectors in suitable contexts.

expected.chinese: 虽然下雨，但是我们还是出门了。
expected.pinyin: suī rán xià yǔ, dàn shì wǒ men hái shì chū mén le.
expected.english: Although it was raining, we still went out.

accepted_answers: 虽然下雨，但是我们还是出门了。

expected.chinese: 虽然这件衣服贵，但是质量很好。
expected.pinyin: suī rán zhè jiàn yī fú guì, dàn shì zhì liàng hěn hǎo.
expected.english: Although this piece of clothing is expensive, its quality is very good.

accepted_answers: 虽然这件衣服贵，但是质量很好。

expected.chinese: 虽然他很忙，但是每天都运动。
expected.pinyin: suī rán tā hěn máng, dàn shì měi tiān dōu yùn dòng.
expected.english: Although he is busy, he exercises every day.

accepted_answers: 虽然他很忙，但是每天都运动。

expected.chinese: 虽然我学过，但是已经忘了。

accepted_answers: 虽然我学过，但是已经忘了。

expected.chinese: 虽然路很远，但是风景很美。

expected.chinese: 虽然今天冷，但是没有风。

expected.chinese: 虽然这道题难，但是我想试试。
expected.pinyin: suī rán zhè dào tí nán, dàn shì wǒ xiǎng shì shì.

accepted_answers: 虽然这道题难，但是我想试试。

exercises.prompt_english: Although the room is small, it is comfortable.

expected.chinese: 虽然房间小，但是很舒服。

accepted_answers: 虽然我不同意，但是我理解你的想法。

rules.title: Conditions with 如果…就…
rules.explanation: Use 如果 to introduce a hypothetical condition. 就 usually appears before the main-clause verb, after its subject. An English conditional does not require a special verb tense in Chinese.

exercises.prompt_english: If it rains tomorrow, we will not go.

expected.chinese: 如果明天下雨，我们就不去了。
expected.pinyin: rú guǒ míng tiān xià yǔ, wǒ men jiù bù qù le.
expected.english: If it rains tomorrow, we will not go.

accepted_answers: 如果明天下雨，我们就不去了。

expected.chinese: 如果你有时间，就给我打电话。
expected.pinyin: rú guǒ nǐ yǒu shí jiān, jiù gěi wǒ dǎ diàn huà.
expected.english: If you have time, call me.

accepted_answers: 如果你有时间，就给我打电话。

exercises.prompt_english: If he comes, I will tell you.

rules.title: Sufficient conditions with 只要…就…
rules.explanation: 只要 states a condition sufficient for the result: 'as long as'. It does not mean that this is the only possible route to the result; that necessary-condition meaning belongs to 只有…才….

exercises.prompt_english: As long as you work hard, you will improve.

expected.pinyin: zhǐ yào nǐ nǔ lì, jiù huì jìn bù.
expected.english: As long as you work hard, you will improve.

exercises.prompt_english: As long as it does not rain, we will go hiking.

expected.chinese: 只要不下雨，我们就去爬山。
expected.pinyin: zhǐ yào bù xià yǔ, wǒ men jiù qù pá shān.
expected.english: As long as it does not rain, we will go hiking.

accepted_answers: 只要不下雨，我们就去爬山。

exercises.prompt_english: As long as I have time, I will come to see you.

expected.chinese: 只要有时间，我就会来看你。
expected.pinyin: zhǐ yào yǒu shí jiān, wǒ jiù huì lái kàn nǐ.
expected.english: As long as I have time, I will come to see you.

exercises.prompt_english: As long as you bring your passport, you can check in.

exercises.prompt_english: As long as you book in advance, you can get a seat.

expected.english: As long as you book in advance, you can get a seat.

exercises.prompt_english: As long as you practice every day, you will not forget.

expected.english: As long as you practice every day, you will not forget.

exercises.prompt_english: As long as the price is right, I will buy it.

expected.pinyin: zhǐ yào jià gé hé shì, wǒ jiù mǎi.
expected.english: As long as the price is right, I will buy it.

exercises.prompt_english: As long as you tell me the address, I can find it.

expected.chinese: 只要你告诉我地址，我就能找到。
expected.pinyin: zhǐ yào nǐ gào sù wǒ dì zhǐ, wǒ jiù néng zhǎo dào.
expected.english: As long as you tell me the address, I can find it.

accepted_answers: 只要你告诉我地址，我就能找到。

exercises.prompt_english: As long as everyone agrees, we will start.

expected.english: As long as everyone agrees, we will start.

accepted_answers: 只要大家同意，我们就开始。

rules.title: Necessary conditions with 只有…才…
rules.explanation: 只有 introduces a necessary condition: 'only if' or 'only by'. 才 links that requirement to the result. It does not claim the condition by itself guarantees success.

exercises.prompt_english: Only by practicing more can you speak fluently.

expected.chinese: 只有多练习，才能说得流利。
expected.pinyin: zhǐ yǒu duō liàn xí, cái néng shuō de liú lì.
expected.english: Only by practicing more can you speak fluently.

accepted_answers: 只有多练习，才能说得流利。

exercises.prompt_english: You can enter only if you buy a ticket.

expected.pinyin: zhǐ yǒu mǎi piào, cái néng jìn qù.
expected.english: You can enter only if you buy a ticket.

exercises.prompt_english: Only by entering the correct password can you open the file.

exercises.prompt_english: Only on weekends do I have time to cook.

expected.english: Only by flying can we arrive on time.

exercises.prompt_english: You can take photos only if you get permission.

expected.pinyin: zhǐ yǒu qīn zì qù kàn, cái huì míng bái.
expected.english: Only by going to see it yourself will you understand.

expected.chinese: 只有把窗户关上，房间才会暖和。
expected.pinyin: zhǐ yǒu bǎ chuāng hù guān shàng, fáng jiān cái huì nuǎn huo.

exercises.prompt_english: Only by checking carefully can you find these mistakes.

expected.pinyin: zhǐ yǒu rèn zhēn jiǎn chá, cái néng fā xiàn zhè xiē cuò wù.
expected.english: Only by checking carefully can you find these mistakes.

accepted_answers: 只有认真检查，才能发现这些错误。

rules.title: Even if with 即使…也…
rules.explanation: 即使 introduces a hypothetical or conceded condition that does not change the result. Pair it with 也. Unlike ordinary 虽然, 即使 does not require the condition to be an established fact.

exercises.prompt_english: Even if it rains, I will go.

expected.pinyin: jí shǐ xià yǔ, wǒ yě huì qù.
expected.english: Even if it rains, I will go.

exercises.prompt_english: Even if he is busy, he will call home.

expected.chinese: 即使很忙，他也会给家里打电话。
expected.pinyin: jí shǐ hěn máng, tā yě huì gěi jiā lǐ dǎ diàn huà.
expected.english: Even if he is busy, he will call home.

accepted_answers: 即使很忙，他也会给家里打电话。

exercises.prompt_english: Even if I fail, I will not give up.

expected.chinese: 即使失败了，我也不放弃。
expected.pinyin: jí shǐ shī bài le, wǒ yě bù fàng qì.
expected.english: Even if I fail, I will not give up.

accepted_answers: 即使失败了，我也不放弃。

exercises.prompt_english: Even if you do not say it, I know.

expected.pinyin: jí shǐ nǐ bù shuō, wǒ yě zhī dào.
expected.english: Even if you do not say it, I know.

exercises.prompt_english: Even if it is cheap, I do not want to buy it.

expected.pinyin: jí shǐ pián yi, wǒ yě bù xiǎng mǎi.

exercises.prompt_english: Even if you have only ten minutes, you should practice.

expected.chinese: 即使只有十分钟，也要练习。
expected.pinyin: jí shǐ zhǐ yǒu shí fēn zhōng, yě yào liàn xí.
expected.english: Even if you have only ten minutes, you should practice.

accepted_answers: 即使只有十分钟，也要练习。

exercises.prompt_english: Even if nobody helps, she can finish it.

expected.chinese: 即使没有人帮忙，她也能完成。
expected.pinyin: jí shǐ méi yǒu rén bāng máng, tā yě néng wán chéng.
expected.english: Even if nobody helps, she can finish it.

exercises.prompt_english: Even if we take a taxi, we will not make it in time.

expected.pinyin: jí shǐ zuò chū zū chē, yě lái bù jí le.
expected.english: Even if we take a taxi, we will not make it in time.

accepted_answers: 即使坐出租车，也来不及了。

exercises.prompt_english: Even if we live far apart, we can meet often.

expected.chinese: 即使住得远，我们也能常见面。

exercises.prompt_english: Even if you disagree, please hear me out.

expected.pinyin: jí shǐ nǐ bù tóng yì, yě qǐng tīng wǒ shuō wán.
expected.english: Even if you disagree, please hear me out.

accepted_answers: 即使你不同意，也请听我说完。

rules.title: Regardless with 不管…都…
rules.explanation: Use 不管 with a question-word expression or alternatives, followed by 都 or 也, to mean 'no matter'. The question word has an unrestricted meaning here rather than asking a direct question.

exercises.prompt_english: No matter how busy I am, I read every day.

expected.chinese: 不管多忙，我都每天看书。
expected.pinyin: bù guǎn duō máng, wǒ dōu měi tiān kàn shū.
expected.english: No matter how busy I am, I read every day.

accepted_answers: 不管多忙，我都每天看书。

exercises.prompt_english: No matter where you go, I support you.

expected.chinese: 不管你去哪儿，我都支持你。
expected.pinyin: bù guǎn nǐ qù nǎ er, wǒ dōu zhī chí nǐ.
expected.english: No matter where you go, I support you.

accepted_answers: 不管你去哪儿，我都支持你。

exercises.prompt_english: No matter what the weather is like, we must set off.

expected.chinese: 不管天气怎么样，我们都要出发。
expected.pinyin: bù guǎn tiān qì zěn me yàng, wǒ men dōu yào chū fā.
expected.english: No matter what the weather is like, we must set off.

exercises.prompt_english: No matter who comes, they must register.

expected.english: No matter who comes, they must register.

exercises.prompt_english: Whether it is expensive or not, I will buy it.

expected.english: Whether it is expensive or not, I will buy it.

exercises.prompt_english: No matter which one you choose, I agree.

expected.pinyin: bù guǎn nǐ xuǎn nǎ ge, wǒ dōu tóng yì.
expected.english: No matter which one you choose, I agree.

exercises.prompt_english: You can contact me at any time.

expected.english: You can contact me at any time.

accepted_answers: 不管什么时候，你都可以联系我。

exercises.prompt_english: No matter what problems you encounter, do not give up.

expected.chinese: 不管遇到什么问题，都别放弃。
expected.pinyin: bù guǎn yù dào shén me wèn tí, dōu bié fàng qì.

rules.title: Addition with 不但…而且…
rules.pattern: 不但 + first point，而且 + additional point
rules.explanation: Use 不但…而且… for 'not only…but also'. With a shared subject, that subject can precede 不但. When the subjects differ, 不但 commonly comes before the first subject.

exercises.prompt_english: She can speak not only Chinese but also Japanese.

expected.chinese: 她不但会说中文，而且会说日语。
expected.pinyin: tā bù dàn huì shuō zhōng wén, ér qiě huì shuō rì yǔ.
expected.english: She can speak not only Chinese but also Japanese.

accepted_answers: 她不但会说中文，而且会说日语。

exercises.prompt_english: This shop is not only cheap but also has very good service.

expected.english: This shop is not only cheap but also has very good service.

accepted_answers: 这家店不但便宜，而且服务很好。

exercises.prompt_english: He not only finished his work but also helped others.

expected.english: He not only finished his work but also helped others.

exercises.prompt_english: Exercise is not only good for the body but also helps people relax.

expected.chinese: 运动不但对身体好，而且能让人放松。
expected.pinyin: yùn dòng bù dàn duì shēn tǐ hǎo, ér qiě néng ràng rén fàng sōng.
expected.english: Exercise is not only good for the body but also helps people relax.

accepted_answers: 运动不但对身体好，而且能让人放松。

exercises.prompt_english: This room is not only big but also bright.

expected.chinese: 这个房间不但大，而且很亮。
expected.pinyin: zhè ge fáng jiān bù dàn dà, ér qiě hěn liàng.
expected.english: This room is not only big but also bright.

accepted_answers: 这个房间不但大，而且很亮。

exercises.prompt_english: Not only do I like this book, but my younger sister likes it too.

expected.english: Not only do I like this book, but my younger sister likes it too.

accepted_answers: 不但我喜欢这本书，而且我妹妹也喜欢。

exercises.prompt_english: She is not only smart but also very patient.

expected.english: He remembered not only the name but also the address.

rules.title: Besides with 除了…以外，还…
rules.pattern: 除了 + included item + 以外，还/也 + addition
rules.explanation: Use 除了…以外 with 还 or 也 to add something besides the named item. This inclusive use differs from the exception structure 除了…以外，都….

exercises.prompt_english: Besides coffee, I also bought tea.

expected.chinese: 除了咖啡以外，我还买了茶。
expected.pinyin: chú le kā fēi yǐ wài, wǒ hái mǎi le chá.
expected.english: Besides coffee, I also bought tea.

accepted_answers: 除了咖啡以外，我还买了茶。

exercises.prompt_english: Besides reading, he also likes swimming.

expected.chinese: 除了看书以外，他还喜欢游泳。
expected.pinyin: chú le kàn shū yǐ wài, tā hái xǐ huān yóu yǒng.
expected.english: Besides reading, he also likes swimming.

accepted_answers: 除了看书以外，他还喜欢游泳。

expected.english: Besides Beijing, we also went to Xi'an.

expected.english: Besides Monday, I am also free on Wednesday.

exercises.prompt_english: Besides your passport, you also need to bring photos.

accepted_answers: 除了护照以外，你还要带照片。

exercises.prompt_english: Besides the price, we also need to consider the quality.

expected.pinyin: chú le jià gé yǐ wài, wǒ men hái yào kǎo lǜ zhì liàng.
expected.english: Besides the price, we also need to consider the quality.

exercises.prompt_english: Besides the teachers, the students also took part in the activity.

expected.chinese: 除了老师以外，学生也参加了活动。
expected.pinyin: chú le lǎo shī yǐ wài, xué shēng yě cān jiā le huó dòng.
expected.english: Besides the teachers, the students also took part in the activity.

accepted_answers: 除了老师以外，学生也参加了活动。

exercises.prompt_english: Besides cooking, he is also responsible for washing the dishes.

expected.chinese: 除了做饭以外，他还负责洗碗。
expected.pinyin: chú le zuò fàn yǐ wài, tā hái fù zé xǐ wǎn.
expected.english: Besides cooking, he is also responsible for washing the dishes.

accepted_answers: 除了做饭以外，他还负责洗碗。

exercises.prompt_english: Besides this book, I also recommend that one.

expected.chinese: 除了这本书以外，我还推荐那本。
expected.pinyin: chú le zhè běn shū yǐ wài, wǒ hái tuī jiàn nà běn.
expected.english: Besides this book, I also recommend that one.

accepted_answers: 除了这本书以外，我还推荐那本。

rules.title: Exceptions with 除了…以外，都…
rules.pattern: 除了 + exception + 以外，group + 都 + predicate
rules.explanation: Use 除了 to set aside an exception, then 都 to make a statement about the rest of a group. The predicate determines what the exception is; 还 would instead signal addition.

exercises.prompt_english: Everyone has arrived except him.

expected.chinese: 除了他以外，大家都到了。
expected.pinyin: chú le tā yǐ wài, dà jiā dōu dào le.
expected.english: Everyone has arrived except him.

accepted_answers: 除了他以外，大家都到了。

exercises.prompt_english: I work every day except Sunday.

expected.chinese: 除了星期天以外，我每天都上班。
expected.pinyin: chú le xīng qī tiān yǐ wài, wǒ měi tiān dōu shàng bān.
expected.english: I work every day except Sunday.

accepted_answers: 除了星期天以外，我每天都上班。

exercises.prompt_english: I can do all the other questions except this one.

expected.chinese: 除了这道题以外，其他题我都会做。
expected.pinyin: chú le zhè dào tí yǐ wài, qí tā tí wǒ dōu huì zuò.
expected.english: I can do all the other questions except this one.

accepted_answers: 除了这道题以外，其他题我都会做。

exercises.prompt_english: I like all these dishes except the fish.

expected.chinese: 除了鱼以外，这些菜我都喜欢。
expected.pinyin: chú le yú yǐ wài, zhè xiē cài wǒ dōu xǐ huān.
expected.english: I like all these dishes except the fish.

accepted_answers: 除了鱼以外，这些菜我都喜欢。

exercises.prompt_english: All of us have been to Shanghai except Xiao Wang.

expected.chinese: 除了小王以外，我们都去过上海。
expected.pinyin: chú le xiǎo wáng yǐ wài, wǒ men dōu qù guò shàng hǎi.
expected.english: All of us have been to Shanghai except Xiao Wang.

accepted_answers: 除了小王以外，我们都去过上海。

exercises.prompt_english: All the other rooms have been cleaned except the kitchen.

expected.chinese: 除了厨房以外，其他房间都打扫了。
expected.pinyin: chú le chú fáng yǐ wài, qí tā fáng jiān dōu dǎ sǎo le.
expected.english: All the other rooms have been cleaned except the kitchen.

accepted_answers: 除了厨房以外，其他房间都打扫了。

exercises.prompt_english: All the other colors are available except red.

expected.chinese: 除了红色以外，其他颜色都有。
expected.pinyin: chú le hóng sè yǐ wài, qí tā yán sè dōu yǒu.
expected.english: All the other colors are available except red.

accepted_answers: 除了红色以外，其他颜色都有。

exercises.prompt_english: I have read everything except the last page.

expected.chinese: 除了最后一页以外，我都看完了。
expected.pinyin: chú le zuì hòu yī yè yǐ wài, wǒ dōu kàn wán le.
expected.english: I have read everything except the last page.

accepted_answers: 除了最后一页以外，我都看完了。

exercises.prompt_english: All the nearby shops have closed except this one.

expected.chinese: 除了这家店以外，附近的商店都关门了。
expected.pinyin: chú le zhè jiā diàn yǐ wài, fù jìn de shāng diàn dōu guān mén le.
expected.english: All the nearby shops have closed except this one.

accepted_answers: 除了这家店以外，附近的商店都关门了。

exercises.prompt_english: He gets up at six every day except on weekends.

expected.chinese: 除了周末以外，他每天都六点起床。
expected.pinyin: chú le zhōu mò yǐ wài, tā měi tiān dōu liù diǎn qǐ chuáng.
expected.english: He gets up at six every day except on weekends.

accepted_answers: 除了周末以外，他每天都六点起床。

rules.title: Simultaneous actions with 一边…一边…
rules.pattern: 一边 + action A，一边 + action B
rules.explanation: Use 一边…一边… for two activities performed at the same time, typically by the same person. It suits ongoing actions more naturally than brief one-time results.

exercises.prompt_english: I listen to music while cooking.

expected.chinese: 我一边做饭，一边听音乐。
expected.pinyin: wǒ yī biān zuò fàn, yī biān tīng yīn yuè.
expected.english: I listen to music while cooking.

accepted_answers: 我一边做饭，一边听音乐。

exercises.prompt_english: She talks on the phone while walking.

expected.chinese: 她一边走路，一边打电话。
expected.pinyin: tā yī biān zǒu lù, yī biān dǎ diàn huà.
expected.english: She talks on the phone while walking.

accepted_answers: 她一边走路，一边打电话。

exercises.prompt_english: We chat while eating.

expected.chinese: 我们一边吃饭，一边聊天。
expected.pinyin: wǒ men yī biān chī fàn, yī biān liáo tiān.
expected.english: We chat while eating.

accepted_answers: 我们一边吃饭，一边聊天。

exercises.prompt_english: He eats fruit while watching television.

expected.chinese: 他一边看电视，一边吃水果。
expected.pinyin: tā yī biān kàn diàn shì, yī biān chī shuǐ guǒ.
expected.english: He eats fruit while watching television.

accepted_answers: 他一边看电视，一边吃水果。

exercises.prompt_english: The teacher draws diagrams while explaining.

expected.chinese: 老师一边解释，一边画图。
expected.pinyin: lǎo shī yī biān jiě shì, yī biān huà tú.
expected.english: The teacher draws diagrams while explaining.

accepted_answers: 老师一边解释，一边画图。

exercises.prompt_english: The child sings and dances at the same time.

expected.chinese: 孩子一边唱歌，一边跳舞。
expected.pinyin: hái zi yī biān chàng gē, yī biān tiào wǔ.
expected.english: The child sings and dances at the same time.

accepted_answers: 孩子一边唱歌，一边跳舞。

exercises.prompt_english: I take notes while listening in class.

expected.chinese: 我一边听课，一边记笔记。
expected.pinyin: wǒ yī biān tīng kè, yī biān jì bǐ jì.
expected.english: I take notes while listening in class.

accepted_answers: 我一边听课，一边记笔记。

exercises.prompt_english: She talks to me while tidying the room.

expected.chinese: 她一边收拾房间，一边跟我说话。
expected.pinyin: tā yī biān shōu shí fáng jiān, yī biān gēn wǒ shuō huà.
expected.english: She talks to me while tidying the room.

accepted_answers: 她一边收拾房间，一边跟我说话。

exercises.prompt_english: He listens to the news while running.

expected.chinese: 他一边跑步，一边听新闻。
expected.pinyin: tā yī biān pǎo bù, yī biān tīng xīn wén.
expected.english: He listens to the news while running.

accepted_answers: 他一边跑步，一边听新闻。

exercises.prompt_english: We discuss the plan while drinking tea.

expected.chinese: 我们一边喝茶，一边讨论计划。
expected.pinyin: wǒ men yī biān hē chá, yī biān tǎo lùn jì huà.
expected.english: We discuss the plan while drinking tea.

accepted_answers: 我们一边喝茶，一边讨论计划。

rules.title: Immediate sequence with 一…就…
rules.explanation: Use 一…就… for 'as soon as' or an immediate, regular response to a trigger. It can describe one occasion or a recurring pattern, depending on the time context.

exercises.prompt_english: I will call you as soon as I get home.

expected.chinese: 我一到家就给你打电话。
expected.pinyin: wǒ yī dào jiā jiù gěi nǐ dǎ diàn huà.
expected.english: I will call you as soon as I get home.

accepted_answers: 我一到家就给你打电话。

exercises.prompt_english: As soon as he drinks coffee, he cannot get to sleep.

expected.pinyin: tā yī hē kā fēi jiù shuì bù zháo.
expected.english: As soon as he drinks coffee, he cannot get to sleep.

exercises.prompt_english: She cried as soon as she heard the news.

expected.pinyin: tā yī tīng dào xiāo xī jiù kū le.
expected.english: She cried as soon as she heard the news.

exercises.prompt_english: We go to the cafeteria as soon as class ends.

expected.pinyin: wǒ men yī xià kè jiù qù shí táng.
expected.english: We go to the cafeteria as soon as class ends.

exercises.prompt_english: As soon as the door opened, the child ran in.

expected.chinese: 门一开，孩子就跑进来了。
expected.pinyin: mén yī kāi, hái zi jiù pǎo jìn lái le.
expected.english: As soon as the door opened, the child ran in.

accepted_answers: 门一开，孩子就跑进来了。

exercises.prompt_english: I understood as soon as I looked at it.

expected.pinyin: wǒ yī kàn jiù míng bái le.
expected.english: I understood as soon as I looked at it.

exercises.prompt_english: He goes swimming as soon as he has free time.

expected.pinyin: tā yī yǒu kòng jiù qù yóu yǒng.
expected.english: He goes swimming as soon as he has free time.

exercises.prompt_english: We will set off as soon as the rain stops.

expected.pinyin: yǔ yī tíng, wǒ men jiù chū fā.
expected.english: We will set off as soon as the rain stops.

exercises.prompt_english: She fell asleep as soon as she got in the car.

expected.pinyin: tā yī shàng chē jiù shuì zháo le.
expected.english: She fell asleep as soon as she got in the car.

exercises.prompt_english: Tell me as soon as you receive the email.

expected.chinese: 你一收到邮件就告诉我。
expected.pinyin: nǐ yī shōu dào yóu jiàn jiù gào sù wǒ.
expected.english: Tell me as soon as you receive the email.

accepted_answers: 你一收到邮件就告诉我。

rules.title: Ordered steps with 先…再…然后…
rules.pattern: 先 + first action，再 + second，然后 + next
rules.explanation: Use 先, 再, and 然后 to order steps. 再 introduces the next intended action, while 然后 is a general sequence connector. Include only as many stages as the situation needs.

exercises.prompt_english: Wash your hands first, then eat.

expected.pinyin: xiān xǐ shǒu, zài chī fàn.
expected.english: Wash your hands first, then eat.

exercises.prompt_english: We will buy tickets first, then go in.

expected.pinyin: wǒ men xiān mǎi piào, zài jìn qù.
expected.english: We will buy tickets first, then go in.

exercises.prompt_english: Rest a little first, then get back to work.

expected.chinese: 你先休息一下，然后再工作。
expected.pinyin: nǐ xiān xiū xī yī xià, rán hòu zài gōng zuò.
expected.english: Rest a little first, then get back to work.

accepted_answers: 你先休息一下，然后再工作。

exercises.prompt_english: I will check the map first, then decide which way to go.

expected.chinese: 我先查地图，再决定怎么走。
expected.pinyin: wǒ xiān chá dì tú, zài jué dìng zěn me zǒu.
expected.english: I will check the map first, then decide which way to go.

accepted_answers: 我先查地图，再决定怎么走。

exercises.prompt_english: Fill out the form first, then give it to the front desk.

expected.pinyin: xiān tián biǎo, rán hòu jiāo gěi qián tái.
expected.english: Fill out the form first, then give it to the front desk.

exercises.prompt_english: She does her homework first, then watches television.

expected.pinyin: tā xiān zuò zuò yè, zài kàn diàn shì.
expected.english: She does her homework first, then watches television.

exercises.prompt_english: We will eat first, then go to see a movie.

expected.chinese: 我们先吃饭，再去看电影。
expected.pinyin: wǒ men xiān chī fàn, zài qù kàn diàn yǐng.
expected.english: We will eat first, then go to see a movie.

accepted_answers: 我们先吃饭，再去看电影。

exercises.prompt_english: Boil the water first, then add the noodles.

expected.chinese: 先把水烧开，然后放面条。
expected.pinyin: xiān bǎ shuǐ shāo kāi, rán hòu fàng miàn tiáo.
expected.english: Boil the water first, then add the noodles.

accepted_answers: 先把水烧开，然后放面条。

exercises.prompt_english: Listen once first, then read along.

expected.pinyin: nǐ xiān tīng yī biàn, zài gēn zhe dú.
expected.english: Listen once first, then read along.

exercises.prompt_english: I will call to make an appointment first, then go to the hospital.

expected.chinese: 我先打电话预约，再去医院。
expected.pinyin: wǒ xiān dǎ diàn huà yù yuē, zài qù yī yuàn.
expected.english: I will call to make an appointment first, then go to the hospital.

accepted_answers: 我先打电话预约，再去医院。

rules.title: Before with 以前
rules.explanation: Place 以前 after a time or event to mean 'before'. Without a preceding event, 以前 can mean 'formerly'. For a not-yet-completed event, Chinese commonly uses the event phrase without future tense marking.

exercises.prompt_english: Before going to sleep, I read for a little while.

expected.chinese: 睡觉以前，我会看一会儿书。
expected.pinyin: shuì jiào yǐ qián, wǒ huì kàn yī huì er shū.
expected.english: Before going to sleep, I read for a little while.

accepted_answers: 睡觉以前，我会看一会儿书。

exercises.prompt_english: Please turn off the lights before going out.

expected.pinyin: chū mén yǐ qián, qǐng guān dēng.
expected.english: Please turn off the lights before going out.

exercises.prompt_english: You should wash your hands before eating.

expected.pinyin: chī fàn yǐ qián yào xǐ shǒu.
expected.english: You should wash your hands before eating.

exercises.prompt_english: Before coming to China, I could not use chopsticks.

expected.chinese: 来中国以前，我不会用筷子。
expected.pinyin: lái zhōng guó yǐ qián, wǒ bù huì yòng kuài zi.
expected.english: Before coming to China, I could not use chopsticks.

accepted_answers: 来中国以前，我不会用筷子。

exercises.prompt_english: Before the exam, she was nervous.

expected.pinyin: kǎo shì yǐ qián, tā hěn jǐn zhāng.
expected.english: Before the exam, she was nervous.

exercises.prompt_english: Please read the contract carefully before signing.

expected.chinese: 签字以前，请仔细看合同。
expected.pinyin: qiān zì yǐ qián, qǐng zǐ xì kàn hé tóng.
expected.english: Please read the contract carefully before signing.

accepted_answers: 签字以前，请仔细看合同。

exercises.prompt_english: I will definitely arrive before nine.

expected.pinyin: jiǔ diǎn yǐ qián, wǒ yī dìng dào.
expected.english: I will definitely arrive before nine.

exercises.prompt_english: Before starting university, he lived at home.

expected.chinese: 上大学以前，他住在家里。
expected.pinyin: shàng dà xué yǐ qián, tā zhù zài jiā lǐ.
expected.english: Before starting university, he lived at home.

accepted_answers: 上大学以前，他住在家里。

exercises.prompt_english: Check the weather before buying tickets.

expected.pinyin: mǎi piào yǐ qián, xiān kàn kàn tiān qì.
expected.english: Check the weather before buying tickets.

exercises.prompt_english: Before moving, we sold the old furniture.

expected.chinese: 搬家以前，我们卖了旧家具。
expected.pinyin: bān jiā yǐ qián, wǒ men mài le jiù jiā jù.
expected.english: Before moving, we sold the old furniture.

accepted_answers: 搬家以前，我们卖了旧家具。

rules.title: After with 以后
rules.explanation: Place 以后 after a time or event to mean 'after'. Used alone, it can mean 'in the future' or 'later'. The main clause may use 就 or 再 to make the sequence explicit.

exercises.prompt_english: After work, I go to the supermarket.

expected.pinyin: xià bān yǐ hòu, wǒ qù chāo shì.
expected.english: After work, I go to the supermarket.

exercises.prompt_english: Let us take a walk after finishing the meal.

expected.chinese: 吃完饭以后，我们散步吧。
expected.pinyin: chī wán fàn yǐ hòu, wǒ men sàn bù ba.
expected.english: Let us take a walk after finishing the meal.

accepted_answers: 吃完饭以后，我们散步吧。

exercises.prompt_english: After graduating, she wants to become a teacher.

expected.pinyin: bì yè yǐ hòu, tā xiǎng dāng lǎo shī.
expected.english: After graduating, she wants to become a teacher.

exercises.prompt_english: Send me a message after you get home.

expected.pinyin: dào jiā yǐ hòu, gěi wǒ fā gè xiāo xī.
expected.english: Send me a message after you get home.

accepted_answers: 到家以后，给我发个消息。

exercises.prompt_english: After watching the movie, we chatted for a long time.

expected.chinese: 看完电影以后，我们聊了很久。
expected.pinyin: kàn wán diàn yǐng yǐ hòu, wǒ men liáo le hěn jiǔ.
expected.english: After watching the movie, we chatted for a long time.

accepted_answers: 看完电影以后，我们聊了很久。

exercises.prompt_english: Please keep quiet after ten.

expected.pinyin: shí diǎn yǐ hòu, qǐng bǎo chí ān jìng.
expected.english: Please keep quiet after ten.

exercises.prompt_english: After moving, I live closer to the company.

expected.pinyin: bān jiā yǐ hòu, wǒ lí gōng sī gèng jìn le.

exercises.prompt_english: After learning to drive, he rarely takes the bus.

expected.chinese: 学会开车以后，他很少坐公交车。
expected.pinyin: xué huì kāi chē yǐ hòu, tā hěn shǎo zuò gōng jiāo chē.
expected.english: After learning to drive, he rarely takes the bus.

accepted_answers: 学会开车以后，他很少坐公交车。

exercises.prompt_english: After receiving the money, I will send the parcel.

expected.chinese: 收到钱以后，我会寄出包裹。
expected.pinyin: shōu dào qián yǐ hòu, wǒ huì jì chū bāo guǒ.
expected.english: After receiving the money, I will send the parcel.

accepted_answers: 收到钱以后，我会寄出包裹。

exercises.prompt_english: Come and help after washing your hands.

expected.pinyin: xǐ wán shǒu yǐ hòu, zài lái bāng máng.
expected.english: Come and help after washing your hands.

rules.title: Disposal with 把
rules.pattern: Subject + 把 + identifiable object + verb + result
rules.explanation: Use 把 to bring an identifiable affected object before the verb and explain what happens to it. The verb phrase normally includes a result, direction, or other elaboration. Put negation and modal verbs before 把.

exercises.prompt_english: Please close the door.

expected.pinyin: qǐng bǎ mén guān shàng.
expected.english: Please close the door.

exercises.prompt_english: I put the keys on the table.

expected.chinese: 我把钥匙放在桌子上了。
expected.pinyin: wǒ bǎ yào shi fàng zài zhuō zi shàng le.
expected.english: I put the keys on the table.

accepted_answers: 我把钥匙放在桌子上了。

exercises.prompt_english: She finished the homework.

expected.pinyin: tā bǎ zuò yè zuò wán le.
expected.english: She finished the homework.

exercises.prompt_english: Please translate this sentence into Chinese.

expected.english: Please translate this sentence into Chinese.

accepted_answers: 请把这句话翻译成中文。

exercises.prompt_english: He broke the cup.

expected.pinyin: tā bǎ bēi zi dǎ pò le.
expected.english: He broke the cup.

exercises.prompt_english: We moved the meeting to Friday.

expected.chinese: 我们把会议改到星期五了。
expected.pinyin: wǒ men bǎ huì yì gǎi dào xīng qī wǔ le.
expected.english: We moved the meeting to Friday.

rules.title: Learned ability with 会
rules.explanation: Use 会 for a learned skill or knowing how to do something. Contrast 能 for ability under particular circumstances and 可以 for permission. 会 also has a separate predictive use.

rules.explanation: Use 可以 to grant or ask permission. Negative permission is often 不可以 or 不能. 不用 instead means there is no need, so it does not express a prohibition.

exercises.prompt_english: What would you like to drink?

expected.pinyin: nǐ xiǎng hē diǎn shén me?
expected.english: What would you like to drink?

exercises.prompt_english: I do not want to go alone.

expected.pinyin: wǒ bù xiǎng yī gè rén qù.
expected.english: I do not want to go alone.

exercises.prompt_english: He wants to buy a bicycle.

expected.pinyin: tā xiǎng mǎi yī liàng zì xíng chē.
expected.english: He wants to buy a bicycle.

exercises.prompt_english: I would like to talk with you.

expected.pinyin: wǒ xiǎng gēn nǐ tán tán.
expected.english: I would like to talk with you.

exercises.prompt_english: The child wants to play for another ten minutes.

expected.pinyin: hái zi xiǎng zài wán shí fēn zhōng.
expected.english: The child wants to play for another ten minutes.

expected.english: She wants to rest at home for a day.

rules.title: Plans with 打算
rules.explanation: Use 打算 before an action to state an intention or plan. It is a lexical verb, so it can also appear in questions about someone's plans or as a noun meaning 'plan'.

exercises.prompt_english: I plan to go to China next year.

expected.pinyin: wǒ dǎ suàn míng nián qù zhōng guó.
expected.english: I plan to go to China next year.

exercises.prompt_english: What do you plan to do this weekend?

expected.pinyin: nǐ zhōu mò dǎ suàn zuò shén me?
expected.english: What do you plan to do this weekend?

exercises.prompt_english: She plans to look for a job after graduation.

expected.pinyin: tā dǎ suàn bì yè hòu zhǎo gōng zuò.
expected.english: She plans to look for a job after graduation.

exercises.prompt_english: We plan to go by train.

expected.pinyin: wǒ men dǎ suàn zuò huǒ chē qù.
expected.english: We plan to go by train.

exercises.prompt_english: He does not plan to move.

expected.pinyin: tā bù dǎ suàn bān jiā.
expected.english: He does not plan to move.

exercises.prompt_english: I plan to practice for half an hour every day.

expected.chinese: 我打算每天练习半个小时。
expected.pinyin: wǒ dǎ suàn měi tiān liàn xí bàn gè xiǎo shí.
expected.english: I plan to practice for half an hour every day.

accepted_answers: 我打算每天练习半个小时。

exercises.prompt_english: How long do you plan to stay?

expected.pinyin: nǐ dǎ suàn zhù duō jiǔ?
expected.english: How long do you plan to stay?

exercises.prompt_english: They plan to open a cafe.

expected.chinese: 他们打算开一家咖啡馆。
expected.pinyin: tā men dǎ suàn kāi yī jiā kā fēi guǎn.
expected.english: They plan to open a cafe.

accepted_answers: 他们打算开一家咖啡馆。

exercises.prompt_english: I plan to save money first, then buy a car.

expected.pinyin: wǒ dǎ suàn xiān cún qián, zài mǎi chē.
expected.english: I plan to save money first, then buy a car.

exercises.prompt_english: We plan to invite the teacher to take part.

expected.chinese: 我们打算邀请老师来参加。
expected.pinyin: wǒ men dǎ suàn yāo qǐng lǎo shī lái cān jiā.
expected.english: We plan to invite the teacher to take part.

accepted_answers: 我们打算邀请老师来参加。

rules.title: Possibility with 可能
rules.explanation: Place 可能 before the predicate for 'possibly' or 'may'. It expresses uncertainty and does not carry the learned-ability meaning of 会. It can also serve as an adjective meaning 'possible'.

exercises.prompt_english: It may rain tomorrow.

expected.pinyin: míng tiān kě néng huì xià yǔ.
expected.english: It may rain tomorrow.

exercises.prompt_english: He may have forgotten the time.

expected.pinyin: tā kě néng wàng le shí jiān.
expected.english: He may have forgotten the time.

exercises.prompt_english: She may be in a meeting.

expected.pinyin: tā kě néng zài kāi huì.
expected.english: She may be in a meeting.

exercises.prompt_english: This shop may already be closed.

expected.chinese: 这家店可能已经关门了。
expected.pinyin: zhè jiā diàn kě néng yǐ jīng guān mén le.
expected.english: This shop may already be closed.

accepted_answers: 这家店可能已经关门了。

exercises.prompt_english: I may arrive a little late.

expected.pinyin: wǒ kě néng yào wǎn yī diǎn er dào.
expected.english: I may arrive a little late.

exercises.prompt_english: They may no longer be coming.

expected.pinyin: tā men kě néng bù lái le.
expected.english: They may no longer be coming.

exercises.prompt_english: The keys may be in the car.

expected.pinyin: yào shi kě néng zài chē lǐ.
expected.english: The keys may be in the car.

exercises.prompt_english: This approach may be useful.

expected.pinyin: zhè ge bàn fǎ kě néng yǒu yòng.
expected.english: This approach may be useful.

exercises.prompt_english: You may have taken the wrong bag.

expected.pinyin: nǐ kě néng ná cuò bāo le.
expected.english: You may have taken the wrong bag.

exercises.prompt_english: We may go hiking this weekend.

expected.pinyin: zhōu mò wǒ men kě néng qù pá shān.
expected.english: We may go hiking this weekend.

rules.title: Confident inference with 一定
rules.explanation: Use 一定 to express a confident conclusion or a firm commitment, depending on context. 不一定 means 'not necessarily'; 一定不 means 'definitely not', so word order changes the scope.

exercises.prompt_english: He must know the answer.

expected.pinyin: tā yī dìng zhī dào dá àn.
expected.english: He must know the answer.

exercises.prompt_english: You must be tired by now.

expected.pinyin: nǐ yī dìng hěn lèi le.
expected.english: You must be tired by now.

exercises.prompt_english: I will definitely come tomorrow.

expected.pinyin: wǒ míng tiān yī dìng lái.
expected.english: I will definitely come tomorrow.

exercises.prompt_english: This must be your bag.

expected.pinyin: zhè yī dìng shì nǐ de bāo.
expected.english: This must be your bag.

exercises.prompt_english: She will definitely like this gift.

expected.chinese: 她一定会喜欢这个礼物。
expected.pinyin: tā yī dìng huì xǐ huān zhè ge lǐ wù.
expected.english: She will definitely like this gift.

accepted_answers: 她一定会喜欢这个礼物。

exercises.prompt_english: We can definitely find a way.

expected.pinyin: wǒ men yī dìng néng zhǎo dào bàn fǎ.
expected.english: We can definitely find a way.

exercises.prompt_english: Expensive things are not necessarily good.

expected.pinyin: guì de dōng xī bù yī dìng hǎo.
expected.english: Expensive things are not necessarily good.

exercises.prompt_english: He definitely will not forget.

expected.pinyin: tā yī dìng bù huì wàng jì.
expected.english: He definitely will not forget.

exercises.prompt_english: You will not necessarily have time tomorrow.

expected.pinyin: nǐ míng tiān bù yī dìng yǒu shí jiān.
expected.english: You will not necessarily have time tomorrow.

exercises.prompt_english: I will definitely finish on time.

expected.pinyin: wǒ yī dìng àn shí wán chéng.
expected.english: I will definitely finish on time.

rules.title: Continuity with 一直
rules.explanation: Use 一直 to describe an action or state continuing through a relevant period. It can also mean 'straight ahead' with motion, but the examples here focus on continuous duration.

exercises.prompt_english: I have been waiting for you the whole time.

expected.pinyin: wǒ yī zhí zài děng nǐ.
expected.english: I have been waiting for you the whole time.

exercises.prompt_english: She has been living in Beijing all along.

expected.pinyin: tā yī zhí zhù zài běi jīng.
expected.english: She has been living in Beijing all along.

exercises.prompt_english: It has been raining all day today.

expected.pinyin: jīn tiān yī zhí zài xià yǔ.
expected.english: It has been raining all day today.

exercises.prompt_english: He has not replied to my message all this time.

expected.pinyin: tā yī zhí méi huí wǒ de xiāo xī.
expected.english: He has not replied to my message all this time.

exercises.prompt_english: We have always been good friends.

expected.pinyin: wǒ men yī zhí shì hǎo péng yǒu.
expected.english: We have always been good friends.

exercises.prompt_english: This issue has been worrying me all along.

expected.chinese: 这个问题一直让我很担心。
expected.pinyin: zhè ge wèn tí yī zhí ràng wǒ hěn dān xīn.
expected.english: This issue has been worrying me all along.

accepted_answers: 这个问题一直让我很担心。

exercises.prompt_english: She worked continuously until ten at night.

expected.chinese: 她一直工作到晚上十点。
expected.pinyin: tā yī zhí gōng zuò dào wǎn shàng shí diǎn.
expected.english: She worked continuously until ten at night.

accepted_answers: 她一直工作到晚上十点。

exercises.prompt_english: I have always wanted to learn to draw.

expected.pinyin: wǒ yī zhí xiǎng xué huà huà.
expected.english: I have always wanted to learn to draw.

exercises.prompt_english: The door has been open the whole time.

expected.pinyin: mén yī zhí kāi zhe.
expected.english: The door has been open the whole time.

exercises.prompt_english: They have been discussing their travel plans the whole time.

expected.chinese: 他们一直在讨论旅行计划。
expected.pinyin: tā men yī zhí zài tǎo lùn lǚ xíng jì huà.
expected.english: They have been discussing their travel plans the whole time.

accepted_answers: 他们一直在讨论旅行计划。

rules.title: Only with 只
rules.explanation: Put 只 before the predicate or a quantity phrase to limit its scope: 'only'. It is distinct from 只有…才…, which marks a necessary condition, and from the classifier 只 pronounced zhī.

exercises.prompt_english: I only drink tea.

expected.pinyin: wǒ zhǐ hē chá.
expected.english: I only drink tea.

exercises.prompt_english: She bought only one book.

expected.pinyin: tā zhǐ mǎi le yī běn shū.
expected.english: She bought only one book.

exercises.prompt_english: We meet only on weekends.

expected.pinyin: wǒ men zhǐ zài zhōu mò jiàn miàn.
expected.english: We meet only on weekends.

exercises.prompt_english: He can speak only a little Chinese.

expected.pinyin: tā zhǐ huì shuō yī diǎn er zhōng wén.
expected.english: He can speak only a little Chinese.

exercises.prompt_english: This ticket costs only twenty yuan.

expected.pinyin: zhè zhāng piào zhǐ yào èr shí kuài qián.
expected.english: This ticket costs only twenty yuan.

exercises.prompt_english: I only want to rest a little.

expected.pinyin: wǒ zhǐ xiǎng xiū xī yī xià.
expected.english: I only want to rest a little.

exercises.prompt_english: There is only one exit here.

expected.pinyin: zhè lǐ zhǐ yǒu yī gè chū kǒu.
expected.english: There is only one exit here.

exercises.prompt_english: She told only me.

expected.pinyin: tā zhǐ gào sù le wǒ yī gè rén.
expected.english: She told only me.

exercises.prompt_english: I slept for only four hours today.

expected.chinese: 我今天只睡了四个小时。
expected.pinyin: wǒ jīn tiān zhǐ shuì le sì gè xiǎo shí.
expected.english: I slept for only four hours today.

accepted_answers: 我今天只睡了四个小时。

exercises.prompt_english: This shop only sells fruit.

expected.pinyin: zhè jiā diàn zhǐ mài shuǐ guǒ.
expected.english: This shop only sells fruit.

rules.title: Even with 连…都/也…
rules.pattern: 连 + surprising item + 都/也 + predicate
rules.explanation: Use 连 to highlight an extreme or unexpected example, followed by 都 or 也 before the predicate. The statement implies that less surprising cases are included as well.

exercises.prompt_english: He even forgot his own birthday.

expected.chinese: 他连自己的生日都忘了。
expected.pinyin: tā lián zì jǐ de shēng rì dōu wàng le.
expected.english: He even forgot his own birthday.

accepted_answers: 他连自己的生日都忘了。

exercises.prompt_english: Even the teacher cannot solve this question.

expected.chinese: 这道题连老师都不会做。
expected.pinyin: zhè dào tí lián lǎo shī dōu bù huì zuò.
expected.english: Even the teacher cannot solve this question.

accepted_answers: 这道题连老师都不会做。

exercises.prompt_english: I was so busy that I did not even eat lunch.

expected.pinyin: wǒ máng de lián wǔ fàn dōu méi chī.
expected.english: I was so busy that I did not even eat lunch.

exercises.prompt_english: She did not say even a single sentence.

expected.pinyin: tā lián yī jù huà dōu méi shuō.
expected.english: She did not say even a single sentence.

exercises.prompt_english: This place cannot even be found on a map.

expected.chinese: 这个地方连地图上都找不到。
expected.pinyin: zhè ge dì fang lián dì tú shàng dōu zhǎo bù dào.
expected.english: This place cannot even be found on a map.

accepted_answers: 这个地方连地图上都找不到。

exercises.prompt_english: The child ran out without even putting on shoes.

expected.chinese: 孩子连鞋都没穿就跑出去了。
expected.pinyin: hái zi lián xié dōu méi chuān jiù pǎo chū qù le.
expected.english: The child ran out without even putting on shoes.

accepted_answers: 孩子连鞋都没穿就跑出去了。

exercises.prompt_english: He will not even drink water.

expected.pinyin: tā lián shuǐ dōu bù hē.
expected.english: He will not even drink water.

exercises.prompt_english: I do not even know his name.

expected.chinese: 我连他的名字都不知道。
expected.pinyin: wǒ lián tā de míng zì dōu bù zhī dào.
expected.english: I do not even know his name.

accepted_answers: 我连他的名字都不知道。

exercises.prompt_english: It is warm here even in winter.

expected.pinyin: zhè lǐ lián dōng tiān dōu hěn nuǎn huo.
expected.english: It is warm here even in winter.

exercises.prompt_english: She has to work even on weekends.

expected.pinyin: tā lián zhōu mò dōu yào shàng bān.
expected.english: She has to work even on weekends.

rules.title: Unexpected contrast with 却
rules.explanation: Put 却 after the subject and before the predicate to mark a contrast with expectations. Unlike 但是, 却 is an adverb and does not normally stand before a new subject as a clause connector.

exercises.prompt_english: He is tired, yet he cannot get to sleep.

expected.pinyin: tā hěn lèi, què shuì bù zháo.
expected.english: He is tired, yet he cannot get to sleep.

exercises.prompt_english: This shop is small, yet it has many things.

expected.chinese: 这家店很小，东西却很多。
expected.pinyin: zhè jiā diàn hěn xiǎo, dōng xī què hěn duō.
expected.english: This shop is small, yet it has many things.

accepted_answers: 这家店很小，东西却很多。

exercises.prompt_english: I called him, but he did not answer.

expected.chinese: 我给他打了电话，他却没接。
expected.pinyin: wǒ gěi tā dǎ le diàn huà, tā què méi jiē.
expected.english: I called him, but he did not answer.

accepted_answers: 我给他打了电话，他却没接。

exercises.prompt_english: She is not very old, yet she has extensive experience.

expected.chinese: 她年纪不大，经验却很丰富。
expected.pinyin: tā nián jì bù dà, jīng yàn què hěn fēng fù.
expected.english: She is not very old, yet she has extensive experience.

accepted_answers: 她年纪不大，经验却很丰富。

exercises.prompt_english: Everyone left, yet he stayed.

expected.chinese: 大家都走了，他却留下了。
expected.pinyin: dà jiā dōu zǒu le, tā què liú xià le.
expected.english: Everyone left, yet he stayed.

accepted_answers: 大家都走了，他却留下了。

exercises.prompt_english: I want to help, yet I do not know what to do.

expected.chinese: 我想帮忙，却不知道该做什么。
expected.pinyin: wǒ xiǎng bāng máng, què bù zhī dào gāi zuò shén me.
expected.english: I want to help, yet I do not know what to do.

accepted_answers: 我想帮忙，却不知道该做什么。

exercises.prompt_english: Although it was raining, he did not bring an umbrella.

expected.pinyin: suī rán xià yǔ, tā què méi dài sǎn.
expected.english: Although it was raining, he did not bring an umbrella.

exercises.prompt_english: This piece of clothing is expensive, yet its quality is poor.

expected.chinese: 这件衣服很贵，质量却不好。
expected.pinyin: zhè jiàn yī fú hěn guì, zhì liàng què bù hǎo.
expected.english: This piece of clothing is expensive, yet its quality is poor.

accepted_answers: 这件衣服很贵，质量却不好。

exercises.prompt_english: He said he was not hungry, yet he ate two bowls of rice.

expected.chinese: 他说不饿，却吃了两碗饭。
expected.pinyin: tā shuō bù è, què chī le liǎng wǎn fàn.
expected.english: He said he was not hungry, yet he ate two bowls of rice.

accepted_answers: 他说不饿，却吃了两碗饭。

exercises.prompt_english: I waited a long time, yet the bus never came.

expected.chinese: 我等了很久，车却一直没来。
expected.pinyin: wǒ děng le hěn jiǔ, chē què yī zhí méi lái.
expected.english: I waited a long time, yet the bus never came.

accepted_answers: 我等了很久，车却一直没来。

rules.title: Mistaken assumptions with 以为
rules.explanation: Use 以为 to report a belief or assumption that turns out to be wrong or is being questioned. It often contrasts an earlier assumption with a later discovery; 觉得 is more neutral for a current opinion.

exercises.prompt_english: I thought today was Friday, but I was mistaken.

expected.pinyin: wǒ yǐ wéi jīn tiān shì xīng qī wǔ.
expected.english: I thought today was Friday, but I was mistaken.

exercises.prompt_english: She mistakenly thought I had already left.

expected.pinyin: tā yǐ wéi wǒ yǐ jīng zǒu le.
expected.english: She mistakenly thought I had already left.

exercises.prompt_english: I thought this shop was expensive, but it is actually cheap.

expected.chinese: 我以为这家店很贵，其实很便宜。
expected.pinyin: wǒ yǐ wéi zhè jiā diàn hěn guì, qí shí hěn pián yi.
expected.english: I thought this shop was expensive, but it is actually cheap.

accepted_answers: 我以为这家店很贵，其实很便宜。

exercises.prompt_english: He mistakenly thought the exam had been canceled.

expected.pinyin: tā yǐ wéi kǎo shì qǔ xiāo le.
expected.english: He mistakenly thought the exam had been canceled.

exercises.prompt_english: I had thought you would not come.

expected.pinyin: wǒ yǐ wéi nǐ bù huì lái.
expected.english: I had thought you would not come.

exercises.prompt_english: We thought the subway would be slower, but unexpectedly it was faster.

expected.chinese: 我们以为坐地铁更慢，没想到更快。
expected.pinyin: wǒ men yǐ wéi zuò dì tiě gèng màn, méi xiǎng dào gèng kuài.
expected.english: We thought the subway would be slower, but unexpectedly it was faster.

accepted_answers: 我们以为坐地铁更慢，没想到更快。

exercises.prompt_english: She mistakenly thought that was her bag.

expected.pinyin: tā yǐ wéi nà shì tā de bāo.
expected.english: She mistakenly thought that was her bag.

exercises.prompt_english: I had assumed you knew him.

expected.pinyin: wǒ yǐ wéi nǐ rèn shí tā.
expected.english: I had assumed you knew him.

exercises.prompt_english: He thought it would take only ten minutes, but it ended up taking an hour.

expected.chinese: 他以为只要十分钟，结果花了一个小时。
expected.pinyin: tā yǐ wéi zhǐ yào shí fēn zhōng, jié guǒ huā le yī gè xiǎo shí.
expected.english: He thought it would take only ten minutes, but it ended up taking an hour.

accepted_answers: 他以为只要十分钟，结果花了一个小时。

exercises.prompt_english: I thought it was closed, but unexpectedly it was still open.

expected.chinese: 我以为关门了，没想到还开着。
expected.pinyin: wǒ yǐ wéi guān mén le, méi xiǎng dào hái kāi zhe.
expected.english: I thought it was closed, but unexpectedly it was still open.

accepted_answers: 我以为关门了，没想到还开着。

rules.title: Identity with 是
rules.explanation: Use 是 to identify a person or thing with a noun, such as a job or relationship. Chinese does not need an article equivalent to 'a' before a job title.

exercises.prompt_english: I am a student.

expected.pinyin: wǒ shì xué shēng.
expected.english: I am a student.

exercises.prompt_english: She is a teacher.

expected.pinyin: tā shì lǎo shī.
expected.english: She is a teacher.

exercises.prompt_english: He is a doctor.

expected.pinyin: tā shì yī shēng.
expected.english: He is a doctor.

exercises.prompt_english: This is my book.

expected.pinyin: zhè shì wǒ de shū.
expected.english: This is my book.

exercises.prompt_english: That is your cup.

expected.pinyin: nà shì nǐ de bēi zi.
expected.english: That is your cup.

exercises.prompt_english: I am her friend.

expected.pinyin: wǒ shì tā de péng yǒu.
expected.english: I am her friend.

exercises.prompt_english: He is my dad.

expected.pinyin: tā shì wǒ bà bà.
expected.english: He is my dad.

exercises.prompt_english: She is my mom.

expected.pinyin: tā shì wǒ mā mā.
expected.english: She is my mom.

exercises.prompt_english: Today is Monday.

rules.title: Stating age with 岁
rules.explanation: State an age by putting the number and 岁 after the person, without 是. 几岁 is common when asking a young child how old they are.

exercises.prompt_english: I am eighteen years old this year.

expected.pinyin: wǒ jīn nián shí bā suì.
expected.english: I am eighteen years old this year.

exercises.prompt_english: My younger brother is five years old.

expected.pinyin: dì di wǔ suì.
expected.english: My younger brother is five years old.

exercises.prompt_english: My younger sister is three years old.

expected.pinyin: mèi mèi sān suì.
expected.english: My younger sister is three years old.

exercises.prompt_english: My dad is forty years old.

expected.pinyin: wǒ bà bà sì shí suì.
expected.english: My dad is forty years old.

exercises.prompt_english: My mom is thirty-eight years old.

expected.pinyin: wǒ mā mā sān shí bā suì.

exercises.prompt_english: My older sister is twenty years old.

exercises.prompt_english: My older brother is twenty-two years old.
