expected.pinyin: tā de ér zi liù suì.
expected.english: Her son is six years old.

exercises.prompt_english: How old is your daughter?

expected.pinyin: nǐ nǚ ér jǐ suì?
expected.english: How old is your daughter?

exercises.prompt_english: My grandpa is seventy years old.

expected.pinyin: wǒ yé yé qī shí suì.
expected.english: My grandpa is seventy years old.

rules.title: Telling the clock time
rules.explanation: Use 点 for the hour and 分 for minutes; 半 means half past. Chinese can state the current time without 是. Add 上午 or 下午 before the hour when needed.

exercises.prompt_english: It is eight o'clock now.

expected.pinyin: xiàn zài bā diǎn.
expected.english: It is eight o'clock now.

exercises.prompt_english: It is half past nine now.

expected.pinyin: xiàn zài jiǔ diǎn bàn.
expected.english: It is half past nine now.

exercises.prompt_english: It is ten ten now.

expected.pinyin: xiàn zài shí diǎn shí fēn.
expected.english: It is ten ten now.

exercises.prompt_english: It is seven twenty now.

expected.pinyin: xiàn zài qī diǎn èr shí fēn.
expected.english: It is seven twenty now.

exercises.prompt_english: It is half past six now.

expected.pinyin: xiàn zài liù diǎn bàn.
expected.english: It is half past six now.

exercises.prompt_english: It is twelve o'clock now.

expected.pinyin: xiàn zài shí èr diǎn.
expected.english: It is twelve o'clock now.

exercises.prompt_english: It is three in the afternoon now.

expected.pinyin: xiàn zài xià wǔ sān diǎn.
expected.english: It is three in the afternoon now.

exercises.prompt_english: It is ten in the morning now.

expected.pinyin: xiàn zài shàng wǔ shí diǎn.
expected.english: It is ten in the morning now.

exercises.prompt_english: It is four fifty now.

expected.pinyin: xiàn zài sì diǎn wǔ shí fēn.
expected.english: It is four fifty now.

exercises.prompt_english: What time is it now?

expected.pinyin: xiàn zài jǐ diǎn?
expected.english: What time is it now?

rules.title: Asking when with 什么时候
rules.pattern: Subject + 什么时候 + verb phrase？
rules.explanation: Put 什么时候 before the verb to ask when an action happens. It occupies the same position as a time expression in the answer.

exercises.prompt_english: When are you going home?

expected.pinyin: nǐ shén me shí hòu huí jiā?
expected.english: When are you going home?

exercises.prompt_english: When are we eating?

expected.pinyin: wǒ men shén me shí hòu chī fàn?
expected.english: When are we eating?

exercises.prompt_english: When is she coming?

expected.pinyin: tā shén me shí hòu lái?
expected.english: When is she coming?

exercises.prompt_english: When do you have class?

expected.pinyin: nǐ shén me shí hòu shàng kè?
expected.english: When do you have class?

exercises.prompt_english: When is Dad going to Beijing?

expected.pinyin: bà bà shén me shí hòu qù běi jīng?
expected.english: When is Dad going to Beijing?

exercises.prompt_english: When do you go to bed?

expected.pinyin: nǐ shén me shí hòu shuì jiào?
expected.english: When do you go to bed?

exercises.prompt_english: When does he get up?

expected.pinyin: tā shén me shí hòu qǐ chuáng?
expected.english: When does he get up?

exercises.prompt_english: When are we buying tickets?

expected.pinyin: wǒ men shén me shí hòu mǎi piào?
expected.english: When are we buying tickets?

exercises.prompt_english: When do you read books?

expected.pinyin: nǐ shén me shí hòu kàn shū?
expected.english: When do you read books?

exercises.prompt_english: When is Mom cooking?

expected.pinyin: mā mā shén me shí hòu zuò fàn?
expected.english: When is Mom cooking?

rules.title: Going somewhere to do something
rules.explanation: Put a destination after 去 and then add the activity you are going there to do. Chinese does not need a separate word corresponding to the English 'to' before that activity.

exercises.prompt_english: I am going to the store to buy water.

expected.pinyin: wǒ qù shāng diàn mǎi shuǐ.
expected.english: I am going to the store to buy water.

exercises.prompt_english: She is going to school to study Chinese.

expected.pinyin: tā qù xué xiào xué zhōng wén.
expected.english: She is going to school to study Chinese.

exercises.prompt_english: We are going to a restaurant to eat.

expected.pinyin: wǒ men qù fàn diàn chī fàn.
expected.english: We are going to a restaurant to eat.

exercises.prompt_english: He is going to Beijing to see a friend.

expected.pinyin: tā qù běi jīng kàn péng yǒu.
expected.english: He is going to Beijing to see a friend.

exercises.prompt_english: I am going to the hospital to see a doctor.

expected.pinyin: wǒ qù yī yuàn kàn yī shēng.
expected.english: I am going to the hospital to see a doctor.

exercises.prompt_english: My older sister is going to the store to buy clothes.

expected.pinyin: jiě jiě qù shāng diàn mǎi yī fú.
expected.english: My older sister is going to the store to buy clothes.

exercises.prompt_english: We are going to the park to run.

expected.pinyin: wǒ men qù gōng yuán pǎo bù.
expected.english: We are going to the park to run.

exercises.prompt_english: Dad is going to school to pick me up.

expected.pinyin: bà bà qù xué xiào jiē wǒ.
expected.english: Dad is going to school to pick me up.

exercises.prompt_english: I am going to the library to read.

expected.pinyin: wǒ qù tú shū guǎn kàn shū.
expected.english: I am going to the library to read.

exercises.prompt_english: They are going to the store to buy fruit.

expected.pinyin: tā men qù shāng diàn mǎi shuǐ guǒ.
expected.english: They are going to the store to buy fruit.

rules.title: Doing things together with 一起
rules.explanation: Place 一起 before the verb to say that people do something together. The subject can name the group or use a plural pronoun such as 我们.

exercises.prompt_english: We eat breakfast together.

expected.pinyin: wǒ men yī qǐ chī zǎo fàn.
expected.english: We eat breakfast together.

exercises.prompt_english: They study Chinese together.

expected.pinyin: tā men yī qǐ xué zhōng wén.
expected.english: They study Chinese together.

exercises.prompt_english: Mom and I cook together.

expected.pinyin: wǒ hé mā mā yī qǐ zuò fàn.
expected.english: Mom and I cook together.

exercises.prompt_english: We watch a movie together.

expected.pinyin: wǒ men yī qǐ kàn diàn yǐng.
expected.english: We watch a movie together.

exercises.prompt_english: They go to school together.

expected.pinyin: tā men yī qǐ qù xué xiào.
expected.english: They go to school together.

exercises.prompt_english: My younger brother and I play together.

expected.pinyin: wǒ hé dì di yī qǐ wán.
expected.english: My younger brother and I play together.

exercises.prompt_english: We drink tea together.

expected.pinyin: wǒ men yī qǐ hē chá.
expected.english: We drink tea together.

exercises.prompt_english: Dad and Mom buy groceries together.

expected.pinyin: bà bà hé mā mā yī qǐ mǎi cài.
expected.english: Dad and Mom buy groceries together.

exercises.prompt_english: They go home together.

expected.pinyin: tā men yī qǐ huí jiā.
expected.english: They go home together.

exercises.prompt_english: My older sister and I listen to music together.

expected.pinyin: wǒ hé jiě jiě yī qǐ tīng yīn yuè.
expected.english: My older sister and I listen to music together.

rules.title: Everyday frequency with 每
rules.pattern: 每 + time unit + 都 + verb phrase
rules.explanation: Use 每 with a time unit to mean 'every'. 天 and 年 can follow 每 directly, while 星期 and 月 often take 个. 都 before the verb emphasizes the regular pattern.

exercises.prompt_english: I drink milk every day.

expected.pinyin: wǒ měi tiān dōu hē niú nǎi.
expected.english: I drink milk every day.

exercises.prompt_english: She reads books every day.

expected.pinyin: tā měi tiān dōu kàn shū.
expected.english: She reads books every day.

exercises.prompt_english: Dad cooks every day.

expected.pinyin: bà bà měi tiān dōu zuò fàn.
expected.english: Dad cooks every day.

exercises.prompt_english: We go to the park every week.

expected.chinese: 我们每个星期都去公园。
expected.pinyin: wǒ men měi gè xīng qī dōu qù gōng yuán.
expected.english: We go to the park every week.

accepted_answers: 我们每个星期都去公园。

exercises.prompt_english: He buys books every month.

expected.pinyin: tā měi gè yuè dōu mǎi shū.
expected.english: He buys books every month.

exercises.prompt_english: I go to Beijing every year.

expected.pinyin: wǒ měi nián dōu qù běi jīng.
expected.english: I go to Beijing every year.

exercises.prompt_english: My younger sister draws every day.

expected.pinyin: mèi mèi měi tiān dōu huà huà.
expected.english: My younger sister draws every day.

exercises.prompt_english: We study Chinese every day.

expected.pinyin: wǒ men měi tiān dōu xué zhōng wén.
expected.english: We study Chinese every day.

exercises.prompt_english: Mom drinks tea every day.

expected.pinyin: mā mā měi tiān dōu hē chá.
expected.english: Mom drinks tea every day.

exercises.prompt_english: I watch a movie every week.

expected.pinyin: wǒ měi gè xīng qī dōu kàn diàn yǐng.
expected.english: I watch a movie every week.

rules.title: Choosing a better alternative with 与其…不如…
rules.pattern: 与其 + option A，不如 + preferred option B
rules.explanation: Use 与其…不如… to recommend one course of action over another. The second option is presented as more worthwhile; the construction compares choices rather than simply comparing qualities.

exercises.prompt_english: Rather than complain, it is better to find a solution.

expected.pinyin: yǔ qí bào yuàn, bù rú xiǎng bàn fǎ.
expected.english: Rather than complain, it is better to find a solution.

exercises.prompt_english: Rather than wait for him, it is better to leave first.

expected.pinyin: yǔ qí děng tā, bù rú xiān zǒu.
expected.english: Rather than wait for him, it is better to leave first.

exercises.prompt_english: Rather than buy a new one, it is better to repair the old one.

expected.chinese: 与其买新的，不如修好旧的。
expected.pinyin: yǔ qí mǎi xīn de, bù rú xiū hǎo jiù de.
expected.english: Rather than buy a new one, it is better to repair the old one.

accepted_answers: 与其买新的，不如修好旧的。

exercises.prompt_english: Rather than speculate, it is better to ask her directly.

expected.chinese: 与其猜测，不如直接问她。
expected.pinyin: yǔ qí cāi cè, bù rú zhí jiē wèn tā.
expected.english: Rather than speculate, it is better to ask her directly.

accepted_answers: 与其猜测，不如直接问她。

exercises.prompt_english: Rather than work late into the night, it is better to rest early.

expected.chinese: 与其熬夜工作，不如早点休息。
expected.pinyin: yǔ qí áo yè gōng zuò, bù rú zǎo diǎn xiū xī.
expected.english: Rather than work late into the night, it is better to rest early.

accepted_answers: 与其熬夜工作，不如早点休息。

exercises.prompt_english: Rather than pursue quantity, it is better to improve quality.

expected.chinese: 与其追求数量，不如提高质量。
expected.pinyin: yǔ qí zhuī qiú shù liàng, bù rú tí gāo zhì liàng.
expected.english: Rather than pursue quantity, it is better to improve quality.

accepted_answers: 与其追求数量，不如提高质量。

exercises.prompt_english: Rather than argue about who is right, it is better to solve the problem.

expected.chinese: 与其争论谁对谁错，不如解决问题。
expected.pinyin: yǔ qí zhēng lùn shuí duì shuí cuò, bù rú jiě jué wèn tí.
expected.english: Rather than argue about who is right, it is better to solve the problem.

accepted_answers: 与其争论谁对谁错，不如解决问题。

exercises.prompt_english: Rather than save the money, it is better to use it for learning.

expected.chinese: 与其把钱存起来，不如用来学习。
expected.pinyin: yǔ qí bǎ qián cún qǐ lái, bù rú yòng lái xué xí.
expected.english: Rather than save the money, it is better to use it for learning.

accepted_answers: 与其把钱存起来，不如用来学习。

exercises.prompt_english: Rather than change the plan at the last minute, it is better to prepare in advance.

expected.chinese: 与其临时改变计划，不如提前做好准备。
expected.pinyin: yǔ qí lín shí gǎi biàn jì huà, bù rú tí qián zuò hǎo zhǔn bèi.
expected.english: Rather than change the plan at the last minute, it is better to prepare in advance.

accepted_answers: 与其临时改变计划，不如提前做好准备。

exercises.prompt_english: Rather than depend on others, it is better to learn to handle it yourself.

expected.chinese: 与其依赖别人，不如学会自己处理。
expected.pinyin: yǔ qí yī lài bié rén, bù rú xué huì zì jǐ chǔ lǐ.
expected.english: Rather than depend on others, it is better to learn to handle it yourself.

accepted_answers: 与其依赖别人，不如学会自己处理。

rules.title: Choosing a sacrifice with 宁可…也不…
rules.pattern: 宁可 + acceptable sacrifice，也不 + rejected action
rules.explanation: Use 宁可…也不… to express a firm preference, even when the preferred choice has a cost. The speaker accepts the first situation rather than doing the second action.

exercises.prompt_english: I would rather walk than ride in his car.

expected.chinese: 我宁可走路，也不坐他的车。
expected.pinyin: wǒ nìng kě zǒu lù, yě bù zuò tā de chē.
expected.english: I would rather walk than ride in his car.

accepted_answers: 我宁可走路，也不坐他的车。

exercises.prompt_english: She would rather earn less than give up her principles.

expected.chinese: 她宁可少挣钱，也不放弃自己的原则。
expected.pinyin: tā nìng kě shǎo zhèng qián, yě bù fàng qì zì jǐ de yuán zé.
expected.english: She would rather earn less than give up her principles.

accepted_answers: 她宁可少挣钱，也不放弃自己的原则。

exercises.prompt_english: I would rather arrive late than drive fast.

expected.chinese: 我宁可晚点到，也不开快车。
expected.pinyin: wǒ nìng kě wǎn diǎn dào, yě bù kāi kuài chē.
expected.english: I would rather arrive late than drive fast.

accepted_answers: 我宁可晚点到，也不开快车。

exercises.prompt_english: He would rather suffer a loss himself than deceive a friend.

expected.chinese: 他宁可自己吃亏，也不欺骗朋友。
expected.pinyin: tā nìng kě zì jǐ chī kuī, yě bù qī piàn péng yǒu.
expected.english: He would rather suffer a loss himself than deceive a friend.

accepted_answers: 他宁可自己吃亏，也不欺骗朋友。

exercises.prompt_english: We would rather start over than accept such conditions.

expected.chinese: 我们宁可重新开始，也不接受这样的条件。
expected.pinyin: wǒ men nìng kě chóng xīn kāi shǐ, yě bù jiē shòu zhè yàng de tiáo jiàn.
expected.english: We would rather start over than accept such conditions.

accepted_answers: 我们宁可重新开始，也不接受这样的条件。

exercises.prompt_english: She would rather finish it alone than submit substandard work.

expected.chinese: 她宁可一个人完成，也不交出不合格的作品。
expected.pinyin: tā nìng kě yī gè rén wán chéng, yě bù jiāo chū bù hé gé de zuò pǐn.
expected.english: She would rather finish it alone than submit substandard work.

accepted_answers: 她宁可一个人完成，也不交出不合格的作品。

exercises.prompt_english: I would rather spend a little more than buy counterfeit goods.

expected.chinese: 我宁可多花一点钱，也不买假货。

accepted_answers: 我宁可多花一点钱，也不买假货。

exercises.prompt_english: He would rather admit his mistake than make excuses.

expected.chinese: 他宁可承认错误，也不找借口。
expected.pinyin: tā nìng kě chéng rèn cuò wù, yě bù zhǎo jiè kǒu.

accepted_answers: 我宁可暂时失业，也不做违法的事。

exercises.prompt_english: They would rather delay opening than lower safety standards.

expected.chinese: 他们宁可推迟开业，也不降低安全标准。
expected.pinyin: tā men nìng kě tuī chí kāi yè, yě bù jiàng dī ān quán biāo zhǔn.
expected.english: They would rather delay opening than lower safety standards.

accepted_answers: 他们宁可推迟开业，也不降低安全标准。

rules.title: Reasoning from an accepted fact with 既然…就…
rules.explanation: 既然 introduces a fact the speaker treats as established. 就 leads to a decision, suggestion, or conclusion based on that fact, rather than a hypothetical condition.

exercises.prompt_english: Since you have already decided, do not hesitate.

expected.chinese: 既然你已经决定了，就不要犹豫。
expected.pinyin: jì rán nǐ yǐ jīng jué dìng le, jiù bù yào yóu yù.
expected.english: Since you have already decided, do not hesitate.

accepted_answers: 既然你已经决定了，就不要犹豫。

exercises.prompt_english: Since everyone is here, let us begin.

expected.chinese: 既然大家都到了，就开始吧。
expected.pinyin: jì rán dà jiā dōu dào le, jiù kāi shǐ ba.
expected.english: Since everyone is here, let us begin.

accepted_answers: 既然大家都到了，就开始吧。

exercises.prompt_english: Since you promised, you must follow through.

expected.pinyin: jì rán dā yìng le, jiù yào zuò dào.
expected.english: Since you promised, you must follow through.

expected.english: Since there is not enough time, let us discuss the main points first.

accepted_answers: 既然时间不够，就先讨论重点。

exercises.prompt_english: Since he is unwilling, let us not pressure him.

expected.chinese: 既然他不愿意，我们就别勉强他。
expected.pinyin: jì rán tā bù yuàn yì, wǒ men jiù bié miǎn qiǎng tā.
expected.english: Since he is unwilling, let us not pressure him.

accepted_answers: 既然他不愿意，我们就别勉强他。

exercises.prompt_english: Since the problem has been discovered, it should be dealt with promptly.

expected.chinese: 既然发现了问题，就应该及时处理。
expected.pinyin: jì rán fā xiàn le wèn tí, jiù yīng gāi jí shí chǔ lǐ.
expected.english: Since the problem has been discovered, it should be dealt with promptly.

exercises.prompt_english: Since you know the situation, please explain it.

accepted_answers: 既然你了解情况，就请你解释一下。

exercises.prompt_english: Since this road is blocked, let us take another one.

expected.chinese: 既然这条路不通，我们就换一条。

rules.title: Acknowledging a fact with 尽管…仍然…
rules.pattern: 尽管 + fact，subject + 仍然 + contrasting result
rules.explanation: 尽管 introduces an actual circumstance that could have prevented the result. 仍然 means 'still' and highlights that the result holds despite it. This use of 尽管 means 'although', not the separate inviting sense 'feel free to'.

rules.title: Accepting an extreme possibility with 哪怕…也…
rules.pattern: 哪怕 + extreme condition，也 + unchanged response
rules.explanation: 哪怕 introduces even an extreme or minimal hypothetical case. The main clause says what will still hold under that condition; it often expresses determination or the value of even a small amount.

rules.title: Stating an exception with 除非…否则…
rules.pattern: 除非 + necessary exception，否则 + default outcome
rules.explanation: 除非 sets out the exception needed to avoid the outcome after 否则. The structure means 'unless...otherwise...' and does not promise that the exception alone guarantees success.

rules.explanation: 无论 means 'regardless of' and introduces a range of possibilities, usually through a question word or alternatives with 还是. 都 marks the result that stays the same across those possibilities; 无论 is common in formal speech and writing.

rules.title: Arguing from the stronger case with 尚且…更何况…
rules.pattern: Stronger case + 尚且 + difficulty，更何况 + weaker case
rules.explanation: 尚且 means 'even' in a relatively formal argument. If even the first person or situation faces a difficulty, 更何况 implies that the second faces it even more. The second clause often leaves the shared predicate unstated.

rules.explanation: Use 不仅没有…反而… when the expected improvement or event did not happen and the opposite happened instead. This is stronger than merely adding a second fact with 不但…而且….

exercises.prompt_english: The price not only failed to fall; it rose instead.

expected.chinese: 价格不仅没有下降，反而上涨了。
expected.pinyin: jià gé bù jǐn méi yǒu xià jiàng, fǎn ér shàng zhǎng le.
expected.english: The price not only failed to fall; it rose instead.

accepted_answers: 价格不仅没有下降，反而上涨了。

exercises.prompt_english: He not only did not get angry; he laughed instead.

expected.chinese: 他不仅没有生气，反而笑了。
expected.pinyin: tā bù jǐn méi yǒu shēng qì, fǎn ér xiào le.
expected.english: He not only did not get angry; he laughed instead.

accepted_answers: 他不仅没有生气，反而笑了。

exercises.prompt_english: After resting, I not only failed to feel refreshed; I felt sleepier instead.

expected.chinese: 休息以后，我不仅没有精神，反而更困了。
expected.pinyin: xiū xī yǐ hòu, wǒ bù jǐn méi yǒu jīng shén, fǎn ér gèng kùn le.
expected.english: After resting, I not only failed to feel refreshed; I felt sleepier instead.

accepted_answers: 休息以后，我不仅没有精神，反而更困了。

exercises.prompt_english: This explanation not only failed to clear up the misunderstanding; it sparked an argument instead.

expected.chinese: 这次解释不仅没有消除误会，反而引起了争论。
expected.pinyin: zhè cì jiě shì bù jǐn méi yǒu xiāo chú wù huì, fǎn ér yǐn qǐ le zhēng lùn.
expected.english: This explanation not only failed to clear up the misunderstanding; it sparked an argument instead.

accepted_answers: 这次解释不仅没有消除误会，反而引起了争论。

exercises.prompt_english: The number of people not only failed to decrease; it increased instead.

expected.chinese: 人数不仅没有减少，反而增加了。
expected.pinyin: rén shù bù jǐn méi yǒu jiǎn shǎo, fǎn ér zēng jiā le.
expected.english: The number of people not only failed to decrease; it increased instead.

accepted_answers: 人数不仅没有减少，反而增加了。

exercises.prompt_english: She not only did not give up; she worked even harder instead.

expected.chinese: 她不仅没有放弃，反而更加努力了。
expected.pinyin: tā bù jǐn méi yǒu fàng qì, fǎn ér gèng jiā nǔ lì le.
expected.english: She not only did not give up; she worked even harder instead.

accepted_answers: 她不仅没有放弃，反而更加努力了。

exercises.prompt_english: The new rule not only failed to save time; it increased the workload instead.

expected.chinese: 新规定不仅没有节省时间，反而增加了工作量。
expected.pinyin: xīn guī dìng bù jǐn méi yǒu jié shěng shí jiān, fǎn ér zēng jiā le gōng zuò liàng.
expected.english: The new rule not only failed to save time; it increased the workload instead.

accepted_answers: 新规定不仅没有节省时间，反而增加了工作量。

exercises.prompt_english: The rain not only failed to stop; it grew heavier instead.

expected.chinese: 雨不仅没有停，反而越下越大。
expected.pinyin: yǔ bù jǐn méi yǒu tíng, fǎn ér yuè xià yuè dà.
expected.english: The rain not only failed to stop; it grew heavier instead.

accepted_answers: 雨不仅没有停，反而越下越大。

exercises.prompt_english: He not only failed to thank me; he blamed me instead.

expected.chinese: 他不仅没有感谢我，反而责怪我。
expected.pinyin: tā bù jǐn méi yǒu gǎn xiè wǒ, fǎn ér zé guài wǒ.
expected.english: He not only failed to thank me; he blamed me instead.

accepted_answers: 他不仅没有感谢我，反而责怪我。

exercises.prompt_english: After the move, the journey not only failed to get shorter; it became longer instead.

expected.chinese: 搬家后，路程不仅没有缩短，反而变长了。
expected.pinyin: bān jiā hòu, lù chéng bù jǐn méi yǒu suō duǎn, fǎn ér biàn cháng le.
expected.english: After the move, the journey not only failed to get shorter; it became longer instead.

accepted_answers: 搬家后，路程不仅没有缩短，反而变长了。

rules.title: Correcting a characterization with 不是…而是…
rules.pattern: 不是 + rejected explanation，而是 + actual explanation
rules.explanation: Use 不是…而是… to replace an incorrect characterization with the intended one. Keep the two parts parallel, whether they are nouns, actions, or full explanations.

exercises.prompt_english: It is not that I do not want to go; I do not have time.

expected.chinese: 我不是不想去，而是没有时间。
expected.pinyin: wǒ bù shì bù xiǎng qù, ér shì méi yǒu shí jiān.
expected.english: It is not that I do not want to go; I do not have time.

accepted_answers: 我不是不想去，而是没有时间。

exercises.prompt_english: This is not an ending, but a new beginning.

expected.chinese: 这不是结束，而是新的开始。
expected.pinyin: zhè bù shì jié shù, ér shì xīn de kāi shǐ.
expected.english: This is not an ending, but a new beginning.

accepted_answers: 这不是结束，而是新的开始。

exercises.prompt_english: He is not a teacher, but a translator.

expected.pinyin: tā bù shì lǎo shī, ér shì fān yì.
expected.english: He is not a teacher, but a translator.

exercises.prompt_english: The issue is not the price, but the quality.

expected.chinese: 问题不是价格，而是质量。
expected.pinyin: wèn tí bù shì jià gé, ér shì zhì liàng.
expected.english: The issue is not the price, but the quality.

accepted_answers: 问题不是价格，而是质量。

exercises.prompt_english: She did not forget; she deliberately said nothing.

expected.chinese: 她不是忘了，而是故意没说。
expected.pinyin: tā bù shì wàng le, ér shì gù yì méi shuō.
expected.english: She did not forget; she deliberately said nothing.

accepted_answers: 她不是忘了，而是故意没说。

exercises.prompt_english: What we need is not excuses, but action.

expected.chinese: 我们需要的不是借口，而是行动。
expected.pinyin: wǒ men xū yào de bù shì jiè kǒu, ér shì xíng dòng.
expected.english: What we need is not excuses, but action.

accepted_answers: 我们需要的不是借口，而是行动。

exercises.prompt_english: This is not luck, but the result of sustained effort.

expected.chinese: 这不是运气，而是长期努力的结果。
expected.pinyin: zhè bù shì yùn qì, ér shì cháng qī nǔ lì de jié guǒ.
expected.english: This is not luck, but the result of sustained effort.

accepted_answers: 这不是运气，而是长期努力的结果。

exercises.prompt_english: What worries me is not failure, but losing trust.

expected.chinese: 我担心的不是失败，而是失去信任。
expected.pinyin: wǒ dān xīn de bù shì shī bài, ér shì shī qù xìn rèn.
expected.english: What worries me is not failure, but losing trust.

accepted_answers: 我担心的不是失败，而是失去信任。

exercises.prompt_english: He came here not to travel, but to work.

expected.chinese: 他来这里不是为了旅游，而是为了工作。
expected.pinyin: tā lái zhè lǐ bù shì wèi le lǚ yóu, ér shì wèi le gōng zuò.
expected.english: He came here not to travel, but to work.

accepted_answers: 他来这里不是为了旅游，而是为了工作。

exercises.prompt_english: What determines success or failure is not speed, but direction.

expected.chinese: 决定成败的不是速度，而是方向。
expected.pinyin: jué dìng chéng bài de bù shì sù dù, ér shì fāng xiàng.
expected.english: What determines success or failure is not speed, but direction.

accepted_answers: 决定成败的不是速度，而是方向。

rules.title: Offering mutually exclusive choices with 要么…要么…
rules.pattern: 要么 + choice A，要么 + choice B
rules.explanation: 要么…要么… presents alternatives to choose between, often with the implication that one must be selected. Unlike 还是 in a direct choice question, this construction commonly states the available choices.

exercises.prompt_english: We can either take a train or fly.

expected.chinese: 我们要么坐火车，要么坐飞机。
expected.pinyin: wǒ men yào me zuò huǒ chē, yào me zuò fēi jī.
expected.english: We can either take a train or fly.

accepted_answers: 我们要么坐火车，要么坐飞机。

exercises.prompt_english: Either decide now or give up this opportunity.

expected.chinese: 你要么现在决定，要么放弃这次机会。
expected.pinyin: nǐ yào me xiàn zài jué dìng, yào me fàng qì zhè cì jī huì.
expected.english: Either decide now or give up this opportunity.

accepted_answers: 你要么现在决定，要么放弃这次机会。

exercises.prompt_english: Either you come or I go.

expected.pinyin: yào me nǐ lái, yào me wǒ qù.
expected.english: Either you come or I go.

exercises.prompt_english: On weekends I either read or go out for a walk.

expected.chinese: 周末我要么看书，要么出去散步。
expected.pinyin: zhōu mò wǒ yào me kàn shū, yào me chū qù sàn bù.
expected.english: On weekends I either read or go out for a walk.

accepted_answers: 周末我要么看书，要么出去散步。

exercises.prompt_english: This room can be either a study or a guest room.

expected.chinese: 这个房间要么做书房，要么做客房。
expected.pinyin: zhè ge fáng jiān yào me zuò shū fáng, yào me zuò kè fáng.
expected.english: This room can be either a study or a guest room.

accepted_answers: 这个房间要么做书房，要么做客房。

exercises.prompt_english: We must either reduce spending or increase income.

expected.chinese: 我们要么减少开支，要么增加收入。
expected.pinyin: wǒ men yào me jiǎn shǎo kāi zhī, yào me zēng jiā shōu rù.
expected.english: We must either reduce spending or increase income.

accepted_answers: 我们要么减少开支，要么增加收入。

exercises.prompt_english: Either accept the conditions or withdraw from the partnership.

expected.chinese: 你要么接受条件，要么退出合作。
expected.pinyin: nǐ yào me jiē shòu tiáo jiàn, yào me tuì chū hé zuò.
expected.english: Either accept the conditions or withdraw from the partnership.

accepted_answers: 你要么接受条件，要么退出合作。

exercises.prompt_english: Either he did not hear it or he did not understand it.

expected.chinese: 他要么没听见，要么没听懂。
expected.pinyin: tā yào me méi tīng jiàn, yào me méi tīng dǒng.
expected.english: Either he did not hear it or he did not understand it.

accepted_answers: 他要么没听见，要么没听懂。

exercises.prompt_english: For lunch, we can either eat at home or at a nearby restaurant.

expected.chinese: 午饭要么在家吃，要么去附近的饭店吃。
expected.pinyin: wǔ fàn yào me zài jiā chī, yào me qù fù jìn de fàn diàn chī.
expected.english: For lunch, we can either eat at home or at a nearby restaurant.

accepted_answers: 午饭要么在家吃，要么去附近的饭店吃。

exercises.prompt_english: These books can either be donated or kept for us to read.

expected.chinese: 这些书要么捐出去，要么留下自己看。
expected.pinyin: zhè xiē shū yào me juān chū qù, yào me liú xià zì jǐ kàn.
expected.english: These books can either be donated or kept for us to read.

accepted_answers: 这些书要么捐出去，要么留下自己看。

rules.title: Describing recurring alternatives with 不是…就是…
rules.pattern: 不是 + possibility A，就是 + possibility B
rules.explanation: 不是…就是… says that one of two possibilities holds. It often describes a repeated pattern or a deduction, rather than inviting the listener to choose an option.

exercises.prompt_english: On weekends he is either working overtime or away on business.

expected.chinese: 他周末不是加班，就是出差。
expected.pinyin: tā zhōu mò bù shì jiā bān, jiù shì chū chāi.
expected.english: On weekends he is either working overtime or away on business.

accepted_answers: 他周末不是加班，就是出差。

exercises.prompt_english: She is either in the library or in the laboratory.

expected.chinese: 她不是在图书馆，就是在实验室。
expected.pinyin: tā bù shì zài tú shū guǎn, jiù shì zài shí yàn shì.
expected.english: She is either in the library or in the laboratory.

accepted_answers: 她不是在图书馆，就是在实验室。

exercises.prompt_english: Recently it has been either raining or windy.

expected.chinese: 最近不是下雨，就是刮风。
expected.pinyin: zuì jìn bù shì xià yǔ, jiù shì guā fēng.
expected.english: Recently it has been either raining or windy.

accepted_answers: 最近不是下雨，就是刮风。

exercises.prompt_english: Whenever he speaks, he is either complaining or criticizing.

expected.chinese: 他一开口不是抱怨，就是批评。
expected.pinyin: tā yī kāi kǒu bù shì bào yuàn, jiù shì pī píng.
expected.english: Whenever he speaks, he is either complaining or criticizing.

accepted_answers: 他一开口不是抱怨，就是批评。

exercises.prompt_english: This key is either yours or his.

expected.chinese: 这把钥匙不是你的，就是他的。
expected.pinyin: zhè bǎ yào shi bù shì nǐ de, jiù shì tā de.
expected.english: This key is either yours or his.

accepted_answers: 这把钥匙不是你的，就是他的。

exercises.prompt_english: Every day she is either attending meetings or writing reports.

expected.chinese: 她每天不是开会，就是写报告。
expected.pinyin: tā měi tiān bù shì kāi huì, jiù shì xiě bào gào.
expected.english: Every day she is either attending meetings or writing reports.

accepted_answers: 她每天不是开会，就是写报告。

exercises.prompt_english: After school the child is either drawing or building with blocks.

expected.chinese: 孩子放学后不是画画，就是搭积木。
expected.pinyin: hái zi fàng xué hòu bù shì huà huà, jiù shì dā jī mù.
expected.english: After school the child is either drawing or building with blocks.

accepted_answers: 孩子放学后不是画画，就是搭积木。

exercises.prompt_english: At this time he is either on his way or already home.

expected.chinese: 这个时间他不是在路上，就是已经到家了。
expected.pinyin: zhè ge shí jiān tā bù shì zài lù shàng, jiù shì yǐ jīng dào jiā le.
expected.english: At this time he is either on his way or already home.

accepted_answers: 这个时间他不是在路上，就是已经到家了。

exercises.prompt_english: The clothes he buys are either black or gray.

expected.chinese: 他买的衣服不是黑色的，就是灰色的。
expected.pinyin: tā mǎi de yī fú bù shì hēi sè de, jiù shì huī sè de.
expected.english: The clothes he buys are either black or gray.

accepted_answers: 他买的衣服不是黑色的，就是灰色的。

exercises.prompt_english: The people who have come to see me these past few days have been either colleagues or neighbors.

expected.chinese: 这几天来找我的人不是同事，就是邻居。
expected.pinyin: zhè jǐ tiān lái zhǎo wǒ de rén bù shì tóng shì, jiù shì lín jū.
expected.english: The people who have come to see me these past few days have been either colleagues or neighbors.

accepted_answers: 这几天来找我的人不是同事，就是邻居。

rules.title: A consequential trigger with 一旦…就…
rules.explanation: 一旦 means 'once' or 'if...ever' and emphasizes a trigger with an important consequence. The consequence can be automatic, difficult to reverse, or a planned response.

exercises.prompt_english: Once it is signed, the contract takes effect.

expected.pinyin: yī dàn qiān zì, hé tóng jiù shēng xiào.
expected.english: Once it is signed, the contract takes effect.

exercises.prompt_english: Once trust is lost, it is hard to restore.

expected.chinese: 一旦失去信任，就很难恢复。
expected.pinyin: yī dàn shī qù xìn rèn, jiù hěn nán huī fù.
expected.english: Once trust is lost, it is hard to restore.

accepted_answers: 一旦失去信任，就很难恢复。

exercises.prompt_english: Once a problem is discovered, it must be reported immediately.

expected.chinese: 一旦发现问题，就要立即报告。
expected.pinyin: yī dàn fā xiàn wèn tí, jiù yào lì jí bào gào.
expected.english: Once a problem is discovered, it must be reported immediately.

accepted_answers: 一旦发现问题，就要立即报告。

exercises.prompt_english: Once you get used to it, it no longer feels troublesome.

expected.chinese: 一旦习惯了，就不觉得麻烦了。
expected.pinyin: yī dàn xí guàn le, jiù bù jué de má fán le.
expected.english: Once you get used to it, it no longer feels troublesome.

accepted_answers: 一旦习惯了，就不觉得麻烦了。

exercises.prompt_english: If you miss the last bus, you will have to take a taxi.

expected.chinese: 一旦错过末班车，就只能打车了。
expected.pinyin: yī dàn cuò guò mò bān chē, jiù zhǐ néng dǎ chē le.
expected.english: If you miss the last bus, you will have to take a taxi.

accepted_answers: 一旦错过末班车，就只能打车了。

exercises.prompt_english: Once you start, do not give up easily.

expected.chinese: 一旦开始，就不要轻易放弃。
expected.pinyin: yī dàn kāi shǐ, jiù bù yào qīng yì fàng qì.
expected.english: Once you start, do not give up easily.

accepted_answers: 一旦开始，就不要轻易放弃。

exercises.prompt_english: Once the water level exceeds this line, an alarm will sound.

expected.chinese: 一旦水位超过这条线，就会发出警报。
expected.pinyin: yī dàn shuǐ wèi chāo guò zhè tiáo xiàn, jiù huì fā chū jǐng bào.
expected.english: Once the water level exceeds this line, an alarm will sound.

accepted_answers: 一旦水位超过这条线，就会发出警报。

exercises.prompt_english: Once the password is leaked, the account could be stolen.

expected.chinese: 一旦泄露密码，账户就可能被盗。
expected.pinyin: yī dàn xiè lù mì mǎ, zhàng hù jiù kě néng bèi dào.
expected.english: Once the password is leaked, the account could be stolen.

accepted_answers: 一旦泄露密码，账户就可能被盗。

exercises.prompt_english: As soon as there is news, I will notify you.

expected.chinese: 一旦有消息，我就通知你。
expected.pinyin: yī dàn yǒu xiāo xī, wǒ jiù tōng zhī nǐ.
expected.english: As soon as there is news, I will notify you.

accepted_answers: 一旦有消息，我就通知你。

exercises.prompt_english: Once you make a promise, you should keep it.

expected.chinese: 一旦做出承诺，就应该遵守。
expected.pinyin: yī dàn zuò chū chéng nuò, jiù yīng gāi zūn shǒu.
expected.english: Once you make a promise, you should keep it.

accepted_answers: 一旦做出承诺，就应该遵守。

rules.title: Preparing for a contingency with 万一
rules.pattern: 万一 + unlikely unwanted event，response / 怎么办？
rules.explanation: 万一 introduces an unlikely but possible event that the speaker wants to prepare for. It often appears with a precaution or 怎么办 to ask what to do if the event happens.

exercises.prompt_english: If it happens to rain, we will hold it indoors instead.

expected.chinese: 万一下雨，我们就改在室内举行。
expected.pinyin: wàn yī xià yǔ, wǒ men jiù gǎi zài shì nèi jǔ xíng.
expected.english: If it happens to rain, we will hold it indoors instead.

accepted_answers: 万一下雨，我们就改在室内举行。

exercises.prompt_english: What should we do if he does not come?

expected.pinyin: wàn yī tā bù lái, zěn me bàn?
expected.english: What should we do if he does not come?

exercises.prompt_english: Bring the charger; what if your phone runs out of power?

expected.chinese: 带上充电器，万一手机没电呢？
expected.pinyin: dài shàng chōng diàn qì, wàn yī shǒu jī méi diàn ne?
expected.english: Bring the charger; what if your phone runs out of power?

accepted_answers: 带上充电器，万一手机没电呢？

exercises.prompt_english: If you happen to get lost, call me.

expected.chinese: 万一迷路了，就给我打电话。
expected.pinyin: wàn yī mí lù le, jiù gěi wǒ dǎ diàn huà.
expected.english: If you happen to get lost, call me.

accepted_answers: 万一迷路了，就给我打电话。

exercises.prompt_english: If the flight happens to be canceled, we will take a train.

expected.chinese: 万一航班取消，我们就坐火车。
expected.pinyin: wàn yī háng bān qǔ xiāo, wǒ men jiù zuò huǒ chē.
expected.english: If the flight happens to be canceled, we will take a train.

accepted_answers: 万一航班取消，我们就坐火车。

exercises.prompt_english: Bring some extra cash; what if cards are not accepted?

expected.chinese: 多带一点现金，万一不能刷卡呢？
expected.pinyin: duō dài yī diǎn xiàn jīn, wàn yī bù néng shuā kǎ ne?
expected.english: Bring some extra cash; what if cards are not accepted?

accepted_answers: 多带一点现金，万一不能刷卡呢？

exercises.prompt_english: If you happen to forget the password, you can recover it by email.

expected.chinese: 万一忘了密码，可以用邮箱找回。
expected.pinyin: wàn yī wàng le mì mǎ, kě yǐ yòng yóu xiāng zhǎo huí.
expected.english: If you happen to forget the password, you can recover it by email.

expected.english: Who will be responsible if something goes wrong?

exercises.prompt_english: If time runs short, do the most important part first.

expected.english: If time runs short, do the most important part first.

exercises.prompt_english: If you happen to be unable to reach me, contact the front desk.

expected.english: If you happen to be unable to reach me, contact the front desk.

accepted_answers: 万一你联系不上我，就找前台。

rules.title: Preventing an unwanted result with 以免
rules.explanation: 以免 introduces the unwanted result that a precaution is intended to prevent. It means 'to avoid' or 'lest' and is common in instructions and careful written explanations.

exercises.prompt_english: Please leave early to avoid being late.

expected.pinyin: qǐng tí qián chū fā, yǐ miǎn chí dào.
expected.english: Please leave early to avoid being late.

exercises.prompt_english: Write down the address so that you do not forget it.

expected.chinese: 把地址写下来，以免忘记。
expected.pinyin: bǎ dì zhǐ xiě xià lái, yǐ miǎn wàng jì.
expected.english: Write down the address so that you do not forget it.

accepted_answers: 把地址写下来，以免忘记。

exercises.prompt_english: Please speak quietly to avoid disturbing others.

expected.chinese: 请轻声说话，以免打扰别人。
expected.pinyin: qǐng qīng shēng shuō huà, yǐ miǎn dǎ rǎo bié rén.
expected.english: Please speak quietly to avoid disturbing others.

accepted_answers: 请轻声说话，以免打扰别人。

exercises.prompt_english: Back up the files first to avoid losing important material.

expected.chinese: 先备份文件，以免丢失重要资料。
expected.pinyin: xiān bèi fèn wén jiàn, yǐ miǎn diū shī zhòng yào zī liào.
expected.english: Back up the files first to avoid losing important material.

accepted_answers: 先备份文件，以免丢失重要资料。

exercises.prompt_english: Please check carefully to avoid errors.

expected.chinese: 请仔细核对，以免出现错误。
expected.pinyin: qǐng zǐ xì hé duì, yǐ miǎn chū xiàn cuò wù.
expected.english: Please check carefully to avoid errors.

accepted_answers: 请仔细核对，以免出现错误。

exercises.prompt_english: Put the cup farther away so the child does not knock into it.

expected.chinese: 把杯子放远一点，以免孩子碰到。
expected.pinyin: bǎ bēi zi fàng yuǎn yī diǎn, yǐ miǎn hái zi pèng dào.
expected.english: Put the cup farther away so the child does not knock into it.

accepted_answers: 把杯子放远一点，以免孩子碰到。

expected.chinese: 出门前查一下路线，以免走错路。

expected.english: Check the route before leaving to avoid taking the wrong road.

accepted_answers: 出门前查一下路线，以免走错路。

exercises.prompt_english: Please keep the receipt to avoid trouble when returning the item.

expected.chinese: 请保留收据，以免退货时遇到麻烦。
expected.pinyin: qǐng bǎo liú shōu jù, yǐ miǎn tuì huò shí yù dào má fán.
expected.english: Please keep the receipt to avoid trouble when returning the item.

accepted_answers: 请保留收据，以免退货时遇到麻烦。

exercises.prompt_english: Close the window to keep rain from coming in.

expected.chinese: 把窗户关上，以免雨水进来。
expected.pinyin: bǎ chuāng hù guān shàng, yǐ miǎn yǔ shuǐ jìn lái.
expected.english: Close the window to keep rain from coming in.

expected.pinyin: wǒ men zuì hǎo tí qián gōu tōng, yǐ miǎn chǎn shēng wù huì.
expected.english: We had better communicate in advance to avoid misunderstandings.

accepted_answers: 我们最好提前沟通，以免产生误会。

rules.title: Enabling a desired result with 以便
rules.pattern: Preparatory action + 以便 + intended benefit
rules.explanation: 以便 introduces the positive purpose of an action: making a later action possible or easier. It is common in formal requests and differs from 以免, which introduces a result to avoid.

exercises.prompt_english: Please leave your phone number so that we can contact you.

accepted_answers: 请留下电话，以便我们联系您。

accepted_answers: 我把资料整理好了，以便大家查阅。

exercises.prompt_english: Please register in advance so that seats can be arranged.

expected.chinese: 请提前报名，以便安排座位。
expected.pinyin: qǐng tí qián bào míng, yǐ biàn ān pái zuò wèi.
expected.english: Please register in advance so that seats can be arranged.

exercises.prompt_english: We need to confirm the number of people so that we can prepare lunch.

expected.chinese: 我们需要确认人数，以便准备午餐。
expected.pinyin: wǒ men xū yào què rèn rén shù, yǐ biàn zhǔn bèi wǔ cān.
expected.english: We need to confirm the number of people so that we can prepare lunch.

accepted_answers: 我们需要确认人数，以便准备午餐。

exercises.prompt_english: Please write the address clearly so that the courier can find you.

expected.chinese: 请写清楚地址，以便快递员找到您。
expected.pinyin: qǐng xiě qīng chǔ dì zhǐ, yǐ biàn kuài dì yuán zhǎo dào nín.
expected.english: Please write the address clearly so that the courier can find you.

accepted_answers: 请写清楚地址，以便快递员找到您。

exercises.prompt_english: She recorded the lecture so that she could review it later.

expected.chinese: 她录下了讲座，以便以后复习。
expected.pinyin: tā lù xià le jiǎng zuò, yǐ biàn yǐ hòu fù xí.
expected.english: She recorded the lecture so that she could review it later.

accepted_answers: 她录下了讲座，以便以后复习。

exercises.prompt_english: Please send me the questions so that I can prepare in advance.

expected.chinese: 请把问题发给我，以便我提前准备。
expected.pinyin: qǐng bǎ wèn tí fā gěi wǒ, yǐ biàn wǒ tí qián zhǔn bèi.
expected.english: Please send me the questions so that I can prepare in advance.

accepted_answers: 请把问题发给我，以便我提前准备。

exercises.prompt_english: I moved the chair aside so that a wheelchair could pass through.

expected.chinese: 我把椅子挪开了，以便轮椅通过。
expected.pinyin: wǒ bǎ yǐ zi nuó kāi le, yǐ biàn lún yǐ tōng guò.
expected.english: I moved the chair aside so that a wheelchair could pass through.

exercises.prompt_english: We created a group chat so that we could communicate promptly.

expected.chinese: 我们建了一个群，以便及时交流。
expected.pinyin: wǒ men jiàn le yī gè qún, yǐ biàn jí shí jiāo liú.
expected.english: We created a group chat so that we could communicate promptly.

accepted_answers: 我们建了一个群，以便及时交流。

rules.title: Highlighting a cause with 之所以…是因为…
rules.pattern: Subject + 之所以 + result，是因为 + cause
rules.explanation: 之所以 marks the result that needs explanation, and 是因为 introduces its cause. This construction foregrounds why something is true; do not put the cause immediately after 之所以.

exercises.prompt_english: The reason I was late is that traffic was heavy.

expected.chinese: 我之所以迟到，是因为路上堵车。
expected.pinyin: wǒ zhī suǒ yǐ chí dào, shì yīn wèi lù shàng dǔ chē.
expected.english: The reason I was late is that traffic was heavy.

accepted_answers: 我之所以迟到，是因为路上堵车。

exercises.prompt_english: The reason she resigned is that she wanted to continue studying.

expected.chinese: 她之所以辞职，是因为想继续学习。
expected.pinyin: tā zhī suǒ yǐ cí zhí, shì yīn wèi xiǎng jì xù xué xí.
expected.english: The reason she resigned is that she wanted to continue studying.

accepted_answers: 她之所以辞职，是因为想继续学习。

exercises.prompt_english: The reason this shop is popular is that its service is good.

expected.english: The reason this shop is popular is that its service is good.

accepted_answers: 这家店之所以受欢迎，是因为服务很好。

expected.english: The reason he is silent is that he does not know what to say.

accepted_answers: 他之所以沉默，是因为不知道该说什么。

exercises.prompt_english: The reason we changed the plan is that the weather was bad.

expected.chinese: 我们之所以改变计划，是因为天气不好。

expected.english: The reason I object is that the risk is too great.

accepted_answers: 我之所以反对，是因为风险太大。

exercises.prompt_english: The reason she improves quickly is that she practices every day.

expected.english: The reason she improves quickly is that she practices every day.

accepted_answers: 她之所以进步快，是因为每天练习。

exercises.prompt_english: The reason this issue is complicated is that it involves many departments.

expected.chinese: 这个问题之所以复杂，是因为涉及很多部门。

accepted_answers: 这个问题之所以复杂，是因为涉及很多部门。

expected.pinyin: tā zhī suǒ yǐ huí lái, shì yīn wèi fàng xīn bù xià jiā rén.
expected.english: The reason he came back is that he could not stop worrying about his family.

accepted_answers: 他之所以回来，是因为放心不下家人。

exercises.prompt_english: The reason we succeeded is that everyone trusted one another.

expected.chinese: 我们之所以成功，是因为大家互相信任。
expected.pinyin: wǒ men zhī suǒ yǐ chéng gōng, shì yīn wèi dà jiā hù xiāng xìn rèn.
expected.english: The reason we succeeded is that everyone trusted one another.

accepted_answers: 我们之所以成功，是因为大家互相信任。

rules.title: Applying a rule universally with 凡是…都…
rules.pattern: 凡是 + qualifying group，都 + shared rule
rules.explanation: 凡是 introduces every person or thing meeting a condition. 都 applies a statement to the entire group. It is especially useful for policies, generalizations, and formal descriptions.

exercises.prompt_english: Everyone taking part in the activity must register.

expected.chinese: 凡是参加活动的人，都要报名。
expected.pinyin: fán shì cān jiā huó dòng de rén, dōu yào bào míng.
expected.english: Everyone taking part in the activity must register.

expected.pinyin: fán shì guò qī de shí pǐn, dōu bù néng chū shòu.
expected.english: No expired food may be sold.

exercises.prompt_english: Every issue involving safety should be handled carefully.

expected.pinyin: fán shì shè jí ān quán de wèn tí, dōu yīng gāi rèn zhēn chǔ lǐ.

accepted_answers: 凡是答应别人的事，都应该尽力做到。

exercises.prompt_english: All documents requiring a signature are placed here.

expected.pinyin: fán shì fā xiàn cuò wù de rén, dōu kě yǐ tí chū xiū gǎi yì jiàn.

accepted_answers: 凡是发现错误的人，都可以提出修改意见。

rules.title: Remaining unmoved with 任凭…也…
rules.pattern: 任凭 + action/condition，subject + 也 + unchanged response
rules.explanation: 任凭 emphasizes that even persistent efforts or varying circumstances cannot change the main result. With 也 and a negative predicate, it often means 'no matter how much someone tries'.

expected.pinyin: rèn píng wǒ zěn me jiě shì, tā yě bù xiāng xìn.

expected.english: No matter how much everyone tries to persuade her, she will not change her mind.

accepted_answers: 任凭大家劝说，她也不肯改变主意。

accepted_answers: 任凭风怎么吹，这棵树也没有倒。

exercises.prompt_english: No matter how much he shouted, nobody answered.

accepted_answers: 任凭别人怎么评价，她也坚持自己的选择。

expected.english: No matter how much I search, I cannot find that photo.

accepted_answers: 任凭我怎么找，也找不到那张照片。

exercises.prompt_english: No matter how the price changes, he does not plan to sell.

exercises.prompt_english: No matter how much the child pleads, Mom will not agree.

expected.english: No matter how noisy it is outside, he can concentrate on reading.

accepted_answers: 任凭外面多么吵闹，他也能专心看书。

rules.title: Taking advantage of a window with 趁
rules.explanation: 趁 introduces a temporary opportunity or favorable condition for an action. It often means 'while there is still a chance' and can take a short phrase or a clause.

exercises.prompt_english: Let us hurry back while it is still light.

expected.chinese: 趁天还没黑，我们赶快回去吧。
expected.pinyin: chèn tiān hái méi hēi, wǒ men gǎn kuài huí qù ba.
expected.english: Let us hurry back while it is still light.

accepted_answers: 趁天还没黑，我们赶快回去吧。

exercises.prompt_english: Eat it while it is hot.

expected.pinyin: chèn rè chī ba.
expected.english: Eat it while it is hot.

exercises.prompt_english: While everyone is here, let me say a few words.

expected.pinyin: chèn dà jiā dōu zài, wǒ shuō liǎng jù.
expected.english: While everyone is here, let me say a few words.

exercises.prompt_english: Reply to the emails while you have time now.

expected.chinese: 趁现在有空，把邮件回复了吧。
expected.pinyin: chèn xiàn zài yǒu kòng, bǎ yóu jiàn huí fù le ba.
expected.english: Reply to the emails while you have time now.

accepted_answers: 趁现在有空，把邮件回复了吧。

exercises.prompt_english: Let us buy a few things before the shop closes.

expected.chinese: 趁商店还没关门，我们去买点东西。
expected.pinyin: chèn shāng diàn hái méi guān mén, wǒ men qù mǎi diǎn dōng xī.
expected.english: Let us buy a few things before the shop closes.

accepted_answers: 趁商店还没关门，我们去买点东西。

exercises.prompt_english: Learn more skills while you are young.

expected.pinyin: chèn nián qīng, duō xué diǎn běn shì.
expected.english: Learn more skills while you are young.

exercises.prompt_english: I would like to take this opportunity to thank everyone.

expected.chinese: 趁这个机会，我想感谢大家。
expected.pinyin: chèn zhè ge jī huì, wǒ xiǎng gǎn xiè dà jiā.
expected.english: I would like to take this opportunity to thank everyone.

accepted_answers: 趁这个机会，我想感谢大家。

exercises.prompt_english: She rested for a while when the child was asleep.

expected.chinese: 趁孩子睡着了，她休息了一会儿。
expected.pinyin: chèn hái zi shuì zháo le, tā xiū xī le yī huì er.
expected.english: She rested for a while when the child was asleep.

accepted_answers: 趁孩子睡着了，她休息了一会儿。

exercises.prompt_english: Let us air the quilts in the sun while the weather is good.

expected.chinese: 趁天气好，我们把被子晒一晒。
expected.pinyin: chèn tiān qì hǎo, wǒ men bǎ bèi zi shài yī shài.
expected.english: Let us air the quilts in the sun while the weather is good.

accepted_answers: 趁天气好，我们把被子晒一晒。

exercises.prompt_english: Revise it quickly while there is still time.

expected.pinyin: chèn hái lái de jí, gǎn kuài xiū gǎi.
expected.english: Revise it quickly while there is still time.

rules.title: Describing parallel development with 随着
rules.explanation: 随着 introduces a change that accompanies another development. It means 'as' or 'with' in descriptions of gradual change, rather than specifying a single completed event.

exercises.prompt_english: As the temperature falls, the lake begins to freeze.

expected.chinese: 随着气温下降，湖面开始结冰。
expected.pinyin: suí zhe qì wēn xià jiàng, hú miàn kāi shǐ jié bīng.
expected.english: As the temperature falls, the lake begins to freeze.

accepted_answers: 随着气温下降，湖面开始结冰。

exercises.prompt_english: As he gets older, he becomes more patient.

expected.chinese: 随着年龄增长，他变得更有耐心。
expected.pinyin: suí zhe nián líng zēng zhǎng, tā biàn de gèng yǒu nài xīn.
expected.english: As he gets older, he becomes more patient.

accepted_answers: 随着年龄增长，他变得更有耐心。

exercises.prompt_english: As technology advances, costs gradually decrease.

expected.chinese: 随着技术进步，成本逐渐降低。
expected.pinyin: suí zhe jì shù jìn bù, chéng běn zhú jiàn jiàng dī.
expected.english: As technology advances, costs gradually decrease.

accepted_answers: 随着技术进步，成本逐渐降低。

exercises.prompt_english: As the population increases, demand for housing keeps rising.

expected.chinese: 随着人口增加，住房需求不断上升。
expected.pinyin: suí zhe rén kǒu zēng jiā, zhù fáng xū qiú bù duàn shàng shēng.
expected.english: As the population increases, demand for housing keeps rising.

accepted_answers: 随着人口增加，住房需求不断上升。

exercises.prompt_english: As she gains experience, she becomes increasingly confident.

expected.chinese: 随着经验积累，她越来越自信。
expected.pinyin: suí zhe jīng yàn jī lěi, tā yuè lái yuè zì xìn.
expected.english: As she gains experience, she becomes increasingly confident.

accepted_answers: 随着经验积累，她越来越自信。

exercises.prompt_english: As night deepens, there are fewer and fewer people on the streets.

expected.chinese: 随着夜色加深，街上的人越来越少。
expected.pinyin: suí zhe yè sè jiā shēn, jiē shàng de rén yuè lái yuè shǎo.
expected.english: As night deepens, there are fewer and fewer people on the streets.

accepted_answers: 随着夜色加深，街上的人越来越少。

exercises.prompt_english: As their income rises, they begin considering buying a home.

expected.chinese: 随着收入提高，他们开始考虑买房。
expected.pinyin: suí zhe shōu rù tí gāo, tā men kāi shǐ kǎo lǜ mǎi fáng.
expected.english: As their income rises, they begin considering buying a home.

accepted_answers: 随着收入提高，他们开始考虑买房。

exercises.prompt_english: As the investigation progressed, more details were discovered.

expected.chinese: 随着调查深入，更多细节被发现了。
expected.pinyin: suí zhe diào chá shēn rù, gèng duō xì jié bèi fā xiàn le.
expected.english: As the investigation progressed, more details were discovered.

accepted_answers: 随着调查深入，更多细节被发现了。

exercises.prompt_english: As transportation improves, more and more tourists come here.

expected.chinese: 随着交通改善，来这里的游客越来越多。
expected.pinyin: suí zhe jiāo tōng gǎi shàn, lái zhè lǐ de yóu kè yuè lái yuè duō.
expected.english: As transportation improves, more and more tourists come here.

accepted_answers: 随着交通改善，来这里的游客越来越多。

exercises.prompt_english: As the discussion continues, everyone's views gradually converge.

expected.chinese: 随着讨论继续，大家的意见逐渐接近。
expected.pinyin: suí zhe tǎo lùn jì xù, dà jiā de yì jiàn zhú jiàn jiē jìn.
expected.english: As the discussion continues, everyone's views gradually converge.

accepted_answers: 随着讨论继续，大家的意见逐渐接近。

rules.title: Tracing a continuing situation with 自从…以来…
rules.pattern: 自从 + starting event + 以来，continuing development
rules.explanation: 自从 identifies the starting point of a situation that continues or has effects afterward. 以来 makes the span from that point explicit; the main clause often includes 一直, 再也没, or a description of change.

exercises.prompt_english: Ever since moving, I have been taking the subway to work.

expected.chinese: 自从搬家以来，我一直坐地铁上班。
expected.pinyin: zì cóng bān jiā yǐ lái, wǒ yī zhí zuò dì tiě shàng bān.
expected.english: Ever since moving, I have been taking the subway to work.

accepted_answers: 自从搬家以来，我一直坐地铁上班。

exercises.prompt_english: Since meeting her, I have learned a lot.

expected.chinese: 自从认识她以来，我学到了很多。
expected.pinyin: zì cóng rèn shí tā yǐ lái, wǒ xué dào le hěn duō.
expected.english: Since meeting her, I have learned a lot.

accepted_answers: 自从认识她以来，我学到了很多。

exercises.prompt_english: Since graduating, we have met only twice.

expected.chinese: 自从毕业以来，我们只见过两次面。
expected.pinyin: zì cóng bì yè yǐ lái, wǒ men zhǐ jiàn guò liǎng cì miàn.
expected.english: Since graduating, we have met only twice.

accepted_answers: 自从毕业以来，我们只见过两次面。

exercises.prompt_english: Since changing jobs, he has rarely worked overtime.

expected.chinese: 自从换了工作以来，他很少加班。
expected.pinyin: zì cóng huàn le gōng zuò yǐ lái, tā hěn shǎo jiā bān.
expected.english: Since changing jobs, he has rarely worked overtime.

accepted_answers: 自从换了工作以来，他很少加班。

exercises.prompt_english: Since that argument, they have never contacted each other again.

expected.chinese: 自从那次争论以来，他们再也没联系过。
expected.pinyin: zì cóng nà cì zhēng lùn yǐ lái, tā men zài yě méi lián xì guò.
expected.english: Since that argument, they have never contacted each other again.

accepted_answers: 自从那次争论以来，他们再也没联系过。

exercises.prompt_english: Since she started running, her sleep has improved greatly.

expected.chinese: 自从开始跑步以来，她的睡眠好多了。
expected.pinyin: zì cóng kāi shǐ pǎo bù yǐ lái, tā de shuì mián hǎo duō le.
expected.english: Since she started running, her sleep has improved greatly.

accepted_answers: 自从开始跑步以来，她的睡眠好多了。

exercises.prompt_english: Ever since this shop opened, business has been good.

expected.chinese: 自从这家店开业以来，生意一直很好。
expected.pinyin: zì cóng zhè jiā diàn kāi yè yǐ lái, shēng yì yī zhí hěn hǎo.
expected.english: Ever since this shop opened, business has been good.

accepted_answers: 自从这家店开业以来，生意一直很好。

exercises.prompt_english: Since the child was born, our lives have changed greatly.

expected.chinese: 自从孩子出生以来，我们的生活变化很大。
expected.pinyin: zì cóng hái zi chū shēng yǐ lái, wǒ men de shēng huó biàn huà hěn dà.
expected.english: Since the child was born, our lives have changed greatly.

accepted_answers: 自从孩子出生以来，我们的生活变化很大。

exercises.prompt_english: Since the new rule was implemented, accidents have decreased.

expected.chinese: 自从实行新规定以来，事故减少了。
expected.pinyin: zì cóng shí xíng xīn guī dìng yǐ lái, shì gù jiǎn shǎo le.
expected.english: Since the new rule was implemented, accidents have decreased.

accepted_answers: 自从实行新规定以来，事故减少了。

exercises.prompt_english: Ever since coming here, I have been busy every day.

expected.chinese: 自从来到这里以来，我每天都很忙。
expected.pinyin: zì cóng lái dào zhè lǐ yǐ lái, wǒ měi tiān dōu hěn máng.
expected.english: Ever since coming here, I have been busy every day.

accepted_answers: 自从来到这里以来，我每天都很忙。

rules.title: Marking a delayed endpoint with 直到…才…
rules.pattern: 直到 + time/event，subject + 才 + delayed action
rules.explanation: 直到…才… means that an action did not occur until the stated time or event. 才 goes before the delayed action and highlights how late it happened.

exercises.prompt_english: He did not come home until midnight.

expected.pinyin: zhí dào bàn yè, tā cái huí jiā.
expected.english: He did not come home until midnight.

exercises.prompt_english: I did not understand until the teacher explained.

expected.chinese: 直到老师解释，我才明白。
expected.pinyin: zhí dào lǎo shī jiě shì, wǒ cái míng bái.
expected.english: I did not understand until the teacher explained.

accepted_answers: 直到老师解释，我才明白。

exercises.prompt_english: She did not submit her application until the last day.

expected.chinese: 直到最后一天，她才提交申请。
expected.pinyin: zhí dào zuì hòu yī tiān, tā cái tí jiāo shēn qǐng.
expected.english: She did not submit her application until the last day.

accepted_answers: 直到最后一天，她才提交申请。

exercises.prompt_english: We did not leave until the rain stopped.

expected.chinese: 直到雨停了，我们才出发。
expected.pinyin: zhí dào yǔ tíng le, wǒ men cái chū fā.
expected.english: We did not leave until the rain stopped.

accepted_answers: 直到雨停了，我们才出发。

exercises.prompt_english: I did not believe it until I saw the actual object.

expected.chinese: 直到见到实物，我才相信。
expected.pinyin: zhí dào jiàn dào shí wù, wǒ cái xiāng xìn.
expected.english: I did not believe it until I saw the actual object.

accepted_answers: 直到见到实物，我才相信。

exercises.prompt_english: Mom did not start working until the child fell asleep.

expected.chinese: 直到孩子睡着，妈妈才开始工作。
expected.pinyin: zhí dào hái zi shuì zháo, mā mā cái kāi shǐ gōng zuò.
expected.english: Mom did not start working until the child fell asleep.

accepted_answers: 直到孩子睡着，妈妈才开始工作。

exercises.prompt_english: He did not learn the meeting was canceled until he received the notice.

expected.chinese: 直到收到通知，他才知道会议取消了。
expected.pinyin: zhí dào shōu dào tōng zhī, tā cái zhī dào huì yì qǔ xiāo le.
expected.english: He did not learn the meeting was canceled until he received the notice.

accepted_answers: 直到收到通知，他才知道会议取消了。

exercises.prompt_english: I did not appreciate the importance of home until I left my hometown.

expected.chinese: 直到离开家乡，我才体会到家的重要。
expected.pinyin: zhí dào lí kāi jiā xiāng, wǒ cái tǐ huì dào jiā de zhòng yào.
expected.english: I did not appreciate the importance of home until I left my hometown.

accepted_answers: 直到离开家乡，我才体会到家的重要。

exercises.prompt_english: She did not feel reassured until she had checked three times.

expected.chinese: 直到检查了三遍，她才放心。
expected.pinyin: zhí dào jiǎn chá le sān biàn, tā cái fàng xīn.
expected.english: She did not feel reassured until she had checked three times.

accepted_answers: 直到检查了三遍，她才放心。

exercises.prompt_english: Nobody breathed a sigh of relief until the problem was solved.

expected.chinese: 直到问题解决，大家才松了一口气。
expected.pinyin: zhí dào wèn tí jiě jué, dà jiā cái sōng le yī kǒu qì.
expected.english: Nobody breathed a sigh of relief until the problem was solved.

accepted_answers: 直到问题解决，大家才松了一口气。

rules.title: Denying an extreme outcome with 不至于
rules.explanation: 不至于 says that something will not reach a particular, usually undesirable, degree. It can reassure someone or suggest that a reaction is excessive; it does not simply mean that an event is impossible.

exercises.prompt_english: It is only a five-minute delay; we will not miss the entire performance.

expected.chinese: 只是晚了五分钟，不至于错过整场演出。
expected.pinyin: zhǐ shì wǎn le wǔ fēn zhōng, bù zhì yú cuò guò zhěng chǎng yǎn chū.
expected.english: It is only a five-minute delay; we will not miss the entire performance.

accepted_answers: 只是晚了五分钟，不至于错过整场演出。

exercises.prompt_english: He is a little angry, but not to the point of resigning.

expected.chinese: 他有点生气，但不至于辞职。
expected.pinyin: tā yǒu diǎn shēng qì, dàn bù zhì yú cí zhí.
expected.english: He is a little angry, but not to the point of resigning.

accepted_answers: 他有点生气，但不至于辞职。

exercises.prompt_english: Wear an extra layer, and you will not be so cold.

expected.chinese: 多穿一件衣服，就不至于那么冷。
expected.pinyin: duō chuān yī jiàn yī fú, jiù bù zhì yú nà me lěng.
expected.english: Wear an extra layer, and you will not be so cold.

accepted_answers: 多穿一件衣服，就不至于那么冷。

exercises.prompt_english: Make a plan in advance, and you will not end up in a fluster.

expected.chinese: 提前做个计划，就不至于手忙脚乱。
expected.pinyin: tí qián zuò gè jì huà, jiù bù zhì yú shǒu máng jiǎo luàn.
expected.english: Make a plan in advance, and you will not end up in a fluster.

accepted_answers: 提前做个计划，就不至于手忙脚乱。

exercises.prompt_english: This small difficulty will not drive us to give up.

expected.chinese: 这点困难不至于让我们放弃。
expected.pinyin: zhè diǎn kùn nán bù zhì yú ràng wǒ men fàng qì.
expected.english: This small difficulty will not drive us to give up.

accepted_answers: 这点困难不至于让我们放弃。

exercises.prompt_english: Earning a little less will not go so far as to affect our daily lives.

expected.chinese: 少赚一点钱，也不至于影响生活。
expected.pinyin: shǎo zhuàn yī diǎn qián, yě bù zhì yú yǐng xiǎng shēng huó.
expected.english: Earning a little less will not go so far as to affect our daily lives.

accepted_answers: 少赚一点钱，也不至于影响生活。

exercises.prompt_english: Bring some food, and you will not go hungry on the way.

expected.chinese: 带点吃的，路上就不至于饿肚子。
expected.pinyin: dài diǎn chī de, lù shàng jiù bù zhì yú è dù zi.
expected.english: Bring some food, and you will not go hungry on the way.

accepted_answers: 带点吃的，路上就不至于饿肚子。

exercises.prompt_english: Although he is forgetful, he is not so forgetful as to forget his own birthday.

expected.chinese: 他虽然健忘，但不至于忘记自己的生日。
expected.pinyin: tā suī rán jiàn wàng, dàn bù zhì yú wàng jì zì jǐ de shēng rì.
expected.english: Although he is forgetful, he is not so forgetful as to forget his own birthday.

accepted_answers: 他虽然健忘，但不至于忘记自己的生日。

exercises.prompt_english: We disagree, but not enough to argue over it.

expected.chinese: 我们意见不同，但不至于为此吵架。
expected.pinyin: wǒ men yì jiàn bù tóng, dàn bù zhì yú wèi cǐ chǎo jià.
expected.english: We disagree, but not enough to argue over it.

accepted_answers: 我们意见不同，但不至于为此吵架。

exercises.prompt_english: With these savings, we will not fall into hardship for the time being.

expected.chinese: 有这笔存款，我们暂时不至于陷入困境。
expected.pinyin: yǒu zhè bǐ cún kuǎn, wǒ men zàn shí bù zhì yú xiàn rù kùn jìng.
expected.english: With these savings, we will not fall into hardship for the time being.

accepted_answers: 有这笔存款，我们暂时不至于陷入困境。

rules.title: Challenging certainty with 未必
rules.explanation: 未必 means 'not necessarily'. It questions whether a conclusion must be true, rather than asserting the opposite. It commonly challenges assumptions based on price, appearance, or status.

exercises.prompt_english: Expensive things are not necessarily good.

expected.pinyin: guì de dōng xī wèi bì hǎo.
expected.english: Expensive things are not necessarily good.

exercises.prompt_english: He does not necessarily know about this matter.

expected.pinyin: tā wèi bì zhī dào zhè jiàn shì.
expected.english: He does not necessarily know about this matter.

exercises.prompt_english: Having more people does not necessarily mean greater efficiency.

expected.pinyin: rén duō wèi bì xiào lǜ gāo.
expected.english: Having more people does not necessarily mean greater efficiency.

exercises.prompt_english: Leaving now will not necessarily get us there in time.

expected.pinyin: xiàn zài chū fā wèi bì lái de jí.
expected.english: Leaving now will not necessarily get us there in time.

exercises.prompt_english: Her silence does not necessarily mean she disagrees.

expected.chinese: 她不说话，未必是不同意。
expected.pinyin: tā bù shuō huà, wèi bì shì bù tóng yì.
expected.english: Her silence does not necessarily mean she disagrees.

accepted_answers: 她不说话，未必是不同意。

exercises.prompt_english: An experienced person is not necessarily suited to this position.

expected.chinese: 有经验的人未必适合这个职位。
expected.pinyin: yǒu jīng yàn de rén wèi bì shì hé zhè ge zhí wèi.
expected.english: An experienced person is not necessarily suited to this position.

accepted_answers: 有经验的人未必适合这个职位。

exercises.prompt_english: Something that looks easy is not necessarily easy to do.

expected.chinese: 看起来容易的事，做起来未必容易。
expected.pinyin: kàn qǐ lái róng yì de shì, zuò qǐ lái wèi bì róng yì.
expected.english: Something that looks easy is not necessarily easy to do.

accepted_answers: 看起来容易的事，做起来未必容易。

exercises.prompt_english: Moving somewhere else will not necessarily solve the problem.

expected.chinese: 换个地方未必能解决问题。
expected.pinyin: huàn gè dì fang wèi bì néng jiě jué wèn tí.
expected.english: Moving somewhere else will not necessarily solve the problem.

accepted_answers: 换个地方未必能解决问题。

exercises.prompt_english: You will not necessarily like a book that everyone else likes.

expected.chinese: 大家都喜欢的书，你未必喜欢。
expected.pinyin: dà jiā dōu xǐ huān de shū, nǐ wèi bì xǐ huān.
expected.english: You will not necessarily like a book that everyone else likes.

accepted_answers: 大家都喜欢的书，你未必喜欢。

exercises.prompt_english: This failure is not necessarily a bad thing.

expected.pinyin: zhè cì shī bài wèi bì shì huài shì.
expected.english: This failure is not necessarily a bad thing.

rules.title: Acknowledging an unavoidable tendency with 难免
rules.explanation: 难免 means that something is hard to avoid and often understandable under the circumstances. It usually introduces an unwelcome feeling, mistake, or difficulty without blaming the person harshly.

exercises.prompt_english: It is hard not to feel nervous the first time you go on stage.

expected.pinyin: dì yī cì shàng tái, nán miǎn jǐn zhāng.
expected.english: It is hard not to feel nervous the first time you go on stage.

exercises.prompt_english: When work is too busy, mistakes are hard to avoid.

expected.pinyin: gōng zuò tài máng, nán miǎn chū cuò.
expected.english: When work is too busy, mistakes are hard to avoid.

exercises.prompt_english: After being away from home for a long time, homesickness is hard to avoid.

expected.pinyin: lí kāi jiā jiǔ le, nán miǎn xiǎng jiā.
expected.english: After being away from home for a long time, homesickness is hard to avoid.

exercises.prompt_english: When people live together, conflicts are hard to avoid.

expected.chinese: 大家一起生活，难免有矛盾。
expected.pinyin: dà jiā yī qǐ shēng huó, nán miǎn yǒu máo dùn.
expected.english: When people live together, conflicts are hard to avoid.

accepted_answers: 大家一起生活，难免有矛盾。

exercises.prompt_english: When you have just changed jobs, some difficulty adjusting is hard to avoid.

expected.chinese: 刚换工作，难免有些不适应。
expected.pinyin: gāng huàn gōng zuò, nán miǎn yǒu xiē bù shì yìng.
expected.english: When you have just changed jobs, some difficulty adjusting is hard to avoid.

accepted_answers: 刚换工作，难免有些不适应。

exercises.prompt_english: Hearing such news, he can hardly avoid feeling disappointed.

expected.chinese: 听到这样的消息，他难免失望。
expected.pinyin: tīng dào zhè yàng de xiāo xī, tā nán miǎn shī wàng.
expected.english: Hearing such news, he can hardly avoid feeling disappointed.

accepted_answers: 听到这样的消息，他难免失望。

exercises.prompt_english: No matter how thoroughly you prepare, unexpected events are hard to avoid.

expected.chinese: 准备得再充分，也难免遇到意外。
expected.pinyin: zhǔn bèi de zài chōng fèn, yě nán miǎn yù dào yì wài.
expected.english: No matter how thoroughly you prepare, unexpected events are hard to avoid.

accepted_answers: 准备得再充分，也难免遇到意外。

exercises.prompt_english: When learning a new language, saying things incorrectly is hard to avoid.

expected.chinese: 学一门新语言，难免说错话。
expected.pinyin: xué yī mén xīn yǔ yán, nán miǎn shuō cuò huà.
expected.english: When learning a new language, saying things incorrectly is hard to avoid.

accepted_answers: 学一门新语言，难免说错话。

exercises.prompt_english: When driving for a long time, fatigue is hard to avoid.

expected.pinyin: cháng shí jiān kāi chē, nán miǎn pí láo.
expected.english: When driving for a long time, fatigue is hard to avoid.

exercises.prompt_english: Without understanding the situation, misunderstandings are hard to avoid.

expected.chinese: 对情况不了解，难免产生误会。
expected.pinyin: duì qíng kuàng bù liǎo jiě, nán miǎn chǎn shēng wù huì.
expected.english: Without understanding the situation, misunderstandings are hard to avoid.

accepted_answers: 对情况不了解，难免产生误会。

rules.title: Reducing an explanation with 无非
rules.pattern: Subject + 无非 + 是/想/为了 + limited explanation
rules.explanation: 无非 means 'nothing more than' and narrows the possibilities or motives to something the speaker considers simple. It can sound dismissive, so its tone depends on context.

exercises.prompt_english: He simply wants recognition.

expected.pinyin: tā wú fēi shì xiǎng dé dào rèn kě.
expected.english: He simply wants recognition.

exercises.prompt_english: The options are nothing more than these two methods.

expected.pinyin: bàn fǎ wú fēi shì zhè liǎng zhǒng.
expected.english: The options are nothing more than these two methods.

exercises.prompt_english: She is doing this simply to protect her family.

expected.chinese: 她这么做，无非是为了保护家人。
expected.pinyin: tā zhè me zuò, wú fēi shì wèi le bǎo hù jiā rén.
expected.english: She is doing this simply to protect her family.

accepted_answers: 她这么做，无非是为了保护家人。

exercises.prompt_english: I am merely making a suggestion.

expected.pinyin: wǒ wú fēi shì tí gè jiàn yì.
expected.english: I am merely making a suggestion.

exercises.prompt_english: What they are arguing about is nothing more than money.

expected.chinese: 他们争论的无非是钱的问题。
expected.pinyin: tā men zhēng lùn de wú fēi shì qián de wèn tí.
expected.english: What they are arguing about is nothing more than money.

accepted_answers: 他们争论的无非是钱的问题。

exercises.prompt_english: The outcome is simply success or failure.

expected.chinese: 结果无非是成功或失败。
expected.pinyin: jié guǒ wú fēi shì chéng gōng huò shī bài.
expected.english: The outcome is simply success or failure.

accepted_answers: 结果无非是成功或失败。

exercises.prompt_english: He keeps explaining simply because he fears you will misunderstand.

expected.chinese: 他反复解释，无非是怕你误会。
expected.pinyin: tā fǎn fù jiě shì, wú fēi shì pà nǐ wù huì.
expected.english: He keeps explaining simply because he fears you will misunderstand.

accepted_answers: 他反复解释，无非是怕你误会。

exercises.prompt_english: This tool merely helps us save time.

expected.chinese: 这个工具无非是帮我们节省时间。
expected.pinyin: zhè ge gōng jù wú fēi shì bāng wǒ men jié shěng shí jiān.
expected.english: This tool merely helps us save time.

accepted_answers: 这个工具无非是帮我们节省时间。

exercises.prompt_english: All she wants is an apology.

expected.chinese: 她要的无非是一句道歉。
expected.pinyin: tā yào de wú fēi shì yī jù dào qiàn.
expected.english: All she wants is an apology.

accepted_answers: 她要的无非是一句道歉。

exercises.prompt_english: Practicing a few more times just means spending a little more time.

expected.chinese: 多练几次，无非是多花一点时间。
expected.pinyin: duō liàn jǐ cì, wú fēi shì duō huā yī diǎn shí jiān.
expected.english: Practicing a few more times just means spending a little more time.

accepted_answers: 多练几次，无非是多花一点时间。

rules.title: Tentative surprised inference with 莫非
rules.explanation: 莫非 introduces a tentative explanation that has just occurred to the speaker, often with surprise or suspicion. It means 'could it be that...?' rather than directly asking for a known fact.

exercises.prompt_english: Could it be that you two have known each other for a long time?

expected.pinyin: mò fēi nǐ men zǎo jiù rèn shí?
expected.english: Could it be that you two have known each other for a long time?

exercises.prompt_english: Could it be that he forgot today's appointment?

expected.chinese: 莫非他忘了今天的约会？
expected.pinyin: mò fēi tā wàng le jīn tiān de yuē huì?
expected.english: Could it be that he forgot today's appointment?

accepted_answers: 莫非他忘了今天的约会？

exercises.prompt_english: Could this be the shop you mentioned?

expected.chinese: 莫非这就是你说的那家店？
expected.pinyin: mò fēi zhè jiù shì nǐ shuō de nà jiā diàn?
expected.english: Could this be the shop you mentioned?

accepted_answers: 莫非这就是你说的那家店？

exercises.prompt_english: Could it be that she already knows the result?

expected.chinese: 莫非她已经知道结果了？
expected.pinyin: mò fēi tā yǐ jīng zhī dào jié guǒ le?
expected.english: Could it be that she already knows the result?

accepted_answers: 莫非她已经知道结果了？

exercises.prompt_english: Could it be that we took the wrong road?

expected.pinyin: mò fēi wǒ men zǒu cuò lù le?
expected.english: Could it be that we took the wrong road?

exercises.prompt_english: Could it be that you no longer plan to participate?

expected.pinyin: mò fēi nǐ bù dǎ suàn cān jiā le?
expected.english: Could it be that you no longer plan to participate?

exercises.prompt_english: Could it be that the tickets have already sold out?

expected.pinyin: mò fēi mén piào yǐ jīng mài wán le?
expected.english: Could it be that the tickets have already sold out?

exercises.prompt_english: Could it be that he is joking?

expected.pinyin: mò fēi tā shì zài kāi wán xiào?
expected.english: Could it be that he is joking?

exercises.prompt_english: Could it be that you wrote this letter?

expected.pinyin: mò fēi zhè fēng xìn shì nǐ xiě de?
expected.english: Could it be that you wrote this letter?

exercises.prompt_english: Could it be that they left ahead of schedule?

expected.pinyin: mò fēi tā men tí qián chū fā le?
expected.english: Could it be that they left ahead of schedule?

rules.title: Challenging an assumption with 难道
rules.explanation: 难道 marks a rhetorical question expressing disbelief or challenging an assumption. A positive proposition often implies a negative answer, and a negative proposition often implies a positive one. It is stronger than a neutral 吗 question.

exercises.prompt_english: Don't you remember me?

expected.pinyin: nán dào nǐ bù jì de wǒ le ma?
expected.english: Don't you remember me?

exercises.prompt_english: Isn't this clear enough already?

expected.pinyin: nán dào zhè hái bù gòu qīng chǔ ma?
expected.english: Isn't this clear enough already?

exercises.prompt_english: Are we really going to give up just like this?

expected.chinese: 难道我们就这样放弃吗？
expected.pinyin: nán dào wǒ men jiù zhè yàng fàng qì ma?
expected.english: Are we really going to give up just like this?

accepted_answers: 难道我们就这样放弃吗？

exercises.prompt_english: Is money really more important than health?

expected.chinese: 难道钱比健康更重要吗？
expected.pinyin: nán dào qián bǐ jiàn kāng gèng zhòng yào ma?
expected.english: Is money really more important than health?

accepted_answers: 难道钱比健康更重要吗？

exercises.prompt_english: Have you really never made a mistake?

expected.chinese: 难道你从来没犯过错吗？
expected.pinyin: nán dào nǐ cóng lái méi fàn guò cuò ma?
expected.english: Have you really never made a mistake?

accepted_answers: 难道你从来没犯过错吗？

exercises.prompt_english: Is all of this really my responsibility?

expected.chinese: 难道这都是我的责任吗？
expected.pinyin: nán dào zhè dōu shì wǒ de zé rèn ma?
expected.english: Is all of this really my responsibility?

accepted_answers: 难道这都是我的责任吗？

exercises.prompt_english: Didn't you receive the notice?

expected.pinyin: nán dào nǐ méi shōu dào tōng zhī ma?
expected.english: Didn't you receive the notice?

exercises.prompt_english: Does making an effort really have no meaning?

expected.pinyin: nán dào nǔ lì méi yǒu yì yì ma?
expected.english: Does making an effort really have no meaning?

exercises.prompt_english: Do you really believe everything he says?

expected.chinese: 难道他说什么你都相信吗？
expected.pinyin: nán dào tā shuō shén me nǐ dōu xiāng xìn ma?
expected.english: Do you really believe everything he says?

accepted_answers: 难道他说什么你都相信吗？

exercises.prompt_english: Shouldn't we listen to her opinion first?

expected.chinese: 难道我们不应该先听听她的意见吗？
expected.pinyin: nán dào wǒ men bù yīng gāi xiān tīng tīng tā de yì jiàn ma?
expected.english: Shouldn't we listen to her opinion first?

accepted_answers: 难道我们不应该先听听她的意见吗？

rules.title: Insisting on necessity with 非…不可
rules.pattern: Subject + 非 + verb phrase + 不可
rules.explanation: 非…不可 expresses strong necessity or determination: someone absolutely must do something. The two negative-looking parts work together to rule out not doing it; this is stronger than ordinary advice with 应该.

exercises.prompt_english: I absolutely must get to the bottom of this matter.

expected.chinese: 这件事我非弄清楚不可。
expected.pinyin: zhè jiàn shì wǒ fēi nòng qīng chǔ bù kě.
expected.english: I absolutely must get to the bottom of this matter.

accepted_answers: 这件事我非弄清楚不可。

exercises.prompt_english: He insists on making the trip in person.

expected.pinyin: tā fēi qīn zì qù yī tàng bù kě.
expected.english: He insists on making the trip in person.

exercises.prompt_english: This problem absolutely must be solved today.

expected.chinese: 这个问题今天非解决不可。
expected.pinyin: zhè ge wèn tí jīn tiān fēi jiě jué bù kě.
expected.english: This problem absolutely must be solved today.

accepted_answers: 这个问题今天非解决不可。

exercises.prompt_english: She insists on seeing the person in charge.

expected.pinyin: tā fēi jiàn dào fù zé rén bù kě.
expected.english: She insists on seeing the person in charge.

exercises.prompt_english: I am determined to finish this book.

expected.chinese: 我非把这本书看完不可。
expected.pinyin: wǒ fēi bǎ zhè běn shū kàn wán bù kě.
expected.english: I am determined to finish this book.

accepted_answers: 我非把这本书看完不可。

exercises.prompt_english: This money absolutely must be paid back.

expected.pinyin: zhè bǐ qián fēi huán bù kě.
expected.english: This money absolutely must be paid back.

exercises.prompt_english: Do you absolutely have to leave now?

expected.pinyin: nǐ fēi xiàn zài zǒu bù kě ma?
expected.english: Do you absolutely have to leave now?

exercises.prompt_english: This mistake absolutely must be corrected.

expected.pinyin: zhè ge cuò wù fēi gǎi bù kě.
expected.english: This mistake absolutely must be corrected.

exercises.prompt_english: They insist on waiting until the result comes out.

expected.chinese: 他们非等到结果出来不可。
expected.pinyin: tā men fēi děng dào jié guǒ chū lái bù kě.
expected.english: They insist on waiting until the result comes out.

accepted_answers: 他们非等到结果出来不可。

exercises.prompt_english: We absolutely must find the cause.

expected.pinyin: wǒ men fēi zhǎo dào yuán yīn bù kě.
expected.english: We absolutely must find the cause.
